To the north, at the head of the sanctuary, the altar sits above the floor level for all to see.  Once a comforting presence, the altar now seems dead at best, malevolent at worst.

title: [Temple, Altar]
description: The old altar sits overlooking the sanctuary.  From here, the shadows seem deeper, the silence more ominous, as if the sonorous breathing of a majestic life had suddenly ceased, leaving you alone and afraid.  Set into the wall behind the altar is a massive glass window, not yet broken, although a creeping dark stain has spread over it, turning the colors an unwholesome red-black.  Some marble stairs lead down into darkness, providing an alternative to going back to the sanctuary itself.

title: [Wehnimer's, Treehouse]
description: This sturdy wooden platform, built of planks and wedged into a fork of the oak's trunk, provides a place to sit and rest in the shade of an overhanging branch.  A glance through the foliage affords a bird's-eye view of the town square below.

This sturdy wooden platform, built of planks and wedged into a fork of the oak's trunk, provides a place to sit and rest in the shadow of an overhanging branch.  A glance through the foliage affords a bird's-eye view of the lamplit town square below.

title: [Inside Oak Tree]
description: Deep in the hollow of this ancient tree, a few carved wooden stools are clustered around a fine-grained oak slab that serves as a table.  Soft light streams in through a large knothole, softly illuminating the area.  Sequestered from the hustle and bustle of the town square, this quiet chamber offers a cozy haven for weary caregivers.

title: [Wehnimer's, Constabulary]
description: The front room of the local constabulary contains the desk of the town constable.  The oaken floor is scuffed by countless feet dragged across it, obviously most reluctantly.  Behind the desk is a weapon rack.  A strong, ironbound door with a narrow, barred grate leads east.

title: [Catacombs, Dank Cellar]
description: A few brown sewer rats dart across the floor and scurry north, in the direction of the odor of spoiled food and ancient cooking grease.  In a far bleak corner stands a filthy cot, a heap of dirty laundry piled high at its foot.  Anchored into the southern wall is a ladder, which disappears into the total darkness that obscures the vaulted ceiling.

back_command:
;e begin
clear
fput 'climb ladder'
climb_result = waitfor "As you try to climb the ladder, a rung breaks under your weight", "You carefully make your way up the dilapidated ladder."
fput 'stand' unless climb_result == "You carefully make your way up the dilapidated ladder."
end until climb_result == "You carefully make your way up the dilapidated ladder."

title: [Paupers, Diving Tower]
description: The tall, rickety wooden ladder sways slightly under your weight.  The rungs show the wear of many sweaty hands.  Sunlight glints brightly off the water in the pool below.  The pool looks rather small from this height.

The tall, rickety wooden ladder sways slightly under your weight.  The rungs show the wear of many sweaty hands.  Moonlight glistens softly off the water in the pool below.  The pool looks rather small from this height.

title: [Paupers, Diving Tower]
description: The very tall, very rickety wooden ladder sways considerably under your weight.  Below you the pool looks very, very small.

title: [Paupers, Diving Tower]
description: The very tall, very rickety wooden ladder sways considerably under your weight.  Below you the pool looks very, very small.

title: [Paupers, Diving Tower Platform]
description: The narrow platform sways wildly under your weight.  Far below the pool seems nothing more than a bright, insignificant speck.  A short distance above you is the dome of the crystal ceiling.

title: [Frith's Inn, Second Floor]
description: You are on the second floor of the inn.  As you lean over the polished modwir railing that surrounds the open landing, you see the front room below.  The stairway continues up and down here.  To the east is an oak door and to the west a teakwood door bearing a brass plaque.

title: [Frith's Inn, Bedchamber]
description: The welcome sight of a roomy cot bedecked with a featherbed mattress, ice goose down quilt, and plump pillows greets you.  Any weary traveller would gladly rest and restore body and spirits alike in this comfortable, airy chamber.

title: [Helga's, Back Alley]
description: The narrow alley, shaded by the overhanging eaves of the stone and wood buildings that rise on all sides, is full of debris, piles of rags and filth.  A broken wooden chair, an old crate and a trash barrel are piled to either side of the smoke-stained oaken door that leads into the back of the building to the south.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: Two sconces hang here, one unlit and leaving much of the area in darkness.  Of the portion of the wall that is lit up, the misspelled message  "Breware"  has been smeared in blood.

title: [Honeybeer Inn, Upper Hallway]
description: Several doorways open off the hallway, however, only two are currently used as guest rooms.  The chandelier hangs low enough that you must duck your head or risk being splattered with hot tallow should you bump into it.  A slightly worn tapestry carpet has been tacked down the center of the hallway.

title: [Honeybeer Inn, White Room]
description: The ceiling slopes low towards the floor on either side of a round dormer window.  Twin beds with thick down comforters are set to either side of the window, where the ceiling merges with the walls.  A white snowcat fur rug covers the floor between the beds.  Simple cedar chests are at the foot of each bed, filling the air with an agreeably woodsy scent each time their lids are raised.

title: [Trading Post, Upstairs Hallway]
description: Dim light flickers in this dead-end hallway.  The combination of no windows and smoking lamps gives the hallway a hazy look.  The ironbound oak door at the end of the hallway seems out of place, looking stronger and newer than the other doors or even the walls of the trading post.

title: [Trading Post, Office]
description: This office is simple in decoration, but the furniture and art in the room are of fine quality.  The chairs and desk are sturdy and functional.  The floors are refinished and the windows sport new glass and fresh paint.

title: [Bawdy Bard Inn, Hallway]
description: The hallway comes to an end.  To the east, a lone toadstool rests in a large stone pot just in front of a bare granite wall.  The north and south walls as well as the ceiling are also granite, cut directly from the solid rock that supports the mountains hundreds, perhaps thousands, of feet overhead.  These are shored up by thick cedar timbers.  Thick green carpet provides the only vibrant coloration.  A faux-oak door breaks up the monotony of the south wall while a faux-walnut door breaches the north wall.

title: [Horn Room]
description: A long corridor-like room widens out at the south end, much like the bell on a horn.  A bed is placed against the wall at the wide end, and twin toadstools in large stone pots flank the bed to brightly light it.  Light golden carpet covers the floor, and the walls and ceiling are painted a similar color.  Given the bed's positioning and the room's length, one could easily take a running start and jump onto the bed, but the management might frown on that.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Rancid Pool]
description: You are in a murky, rancid pool.  Putrid fumes from the pool make your eyes tear and your skin burn.  Although the pool is not deep, it is difficult to gain a sure footing on the slippery bottom.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Great Cavern]
description: Along the edge of the murky pool, beaded helictite looks like thousands of pearls.  A large outcrop of gypsum flowers grows at the pool's edge.  If not for the rancid odors, this would be a magnificent cavern.

title: [Cysaegir, Copse]
description: Larkspurs, violets, alyssums, and bluebells thrive here by a gurgling brook.  Offering shades of yellow, blue, pink, and purple, their raceme clusters face the sun, and seem to quiver in excitement whenever a soft breeze sweeps across the ground.  Some spiraling stairs twine around a bole and lead to a shop built mid-level on the massive tree.  An exceptionally over-sized branch droops low offering shade and relaxation beside a whitewashed cottage.  Securely strung up between the trees are well-made hammocks, constructed from woven vines.

Larkspurs, violets, alyssums, and bluebells thrive here by a gurgling brook.  In the pale light of the evening, all of the flowers take on the same ghostly hue and seem to quiver in excitement whenever a soft breeze sweeps across the ground.  Some spiraling stairs twine around a bole and lead up to a shop built mid-level on the massive tree.  An exceptionally over-sized branch droops low, offering shade and relaxation beside a whitewashed cottage.  Securely strung up between the trees are well-made hammocks constructed from woven vines.

title: [Piaere's Boutique, Main Room]
description: A sprawling azure canopy, painted like the sky it obscures, shades this open-air platform enclosed by sturdy fel railing.  The massive trunk of a linden tree rises through the heart of this cozy boutique, and several of its thick branches have been converted into makeshift clothing racks.  A florid orange tree nearby scents the air with a heady fragrance, drawing iridescent hummingbirds to flit through the shop in search of sweet nectar.

title: [Emerald Forest, Pool]
description: Tiny fish dart past your legs and gusts of spray from the waterfall wash over your face as you bob in this chilly pool.  Something glints in the crevice of a rock at the very bottom, but the swirling current obscures the details.

title: [Emerald Forest, Stream]
description: A gentle, rushing roar announces the presence of a waterfall leaping over a ledge of rock on the hillside above your head.  The pool which forms at the bottom is small, but still deep enough to preserve a blue-green radiance.  From his perch atop a hummock of moss, a glistening toad serenades the forest.

title: [The Feystone Inn, Upper Landing]
description: Shabby carpeting covers the wooden floorboards, but does nothing to disguise the creaking and groaning underfoot as the few patrons of this dubious establishment wander the hallway.  A battered brass chandelier hangs from the beams above, casting a dim sickly light across the hall.

title: [The Feystone Inn, Sitting Room]
description: Dingy curtains frame an equally grimy window, its glaes panes so dirty that seeing through them is virtually impossible.  A couch, its stuffing popping out in various locations, rests against one wall.  Pushed up against the opposite wall rests a wooden table scarred with gouges and water rings.

title: [Lunule Weald, Perish Glen]
description: A single, huge tree stands in the midst of this small clearing.  Its trunk is wide and thick, its dead branches still reaching for the sky.  Hundreds of tiny, colorful crescent moons are tied to every limb and branch in this tall tree, creating the effect of a rainbow of leaves swaying in the wind.  At the base of the tree, partially covered with debris, is a small hole.

title: [Lunule Weald, Zelia's Shrine]
description: Worms and insects ooze out of the dirt walls and creep along the floor in this small, squat chamber.  In the center of the chamber is a circle of black rocks, the top of each rock is painted with a silver crescent moon.  Inside the circle of rocks sits a stone sculpture of a woman with wild hair driving a chariot pulled by four stallions.  Moonlight streams in from the opening in the short ceiling, striking the sculpture and casting the shadow of a wild-haired woman on the dirt walls.

Worms and insects ooze out of the dirt walls and creep along the floor in this small, squat chamber.  In the center of the chamber is a circle of black rocks, the top of each rock is painted with a silver crescent moon.  Inside the circle of rocks sits a stone sculpture of a woman with wild hair driving a chariot pulled by four stallions.  Light streams in from the opening in the short ceiling, striking the sculpture and casting the shadow of a wild-haired woman on the dirt walls.

title: [River's Rest, Creek]
description: An eddy has formed in a curve of the creek a short distance before it joins the wide Tempest River.  The bottom of the creek, visible through the clear water, consists of small pebbles that have been washed downstream by the current.  The creek bank, a half moon of brown, blue and green pebbles, is surrounded by tall cattails and reeds.  A small wooden footbridge crosses the creek to the north.  In the middle of the creek is an old pier piling.

title: [River's Rest, Creek Bank]
description: The pebbled path leads you to a grassy hillock overlooking the creek.  The creek bank here is rather steep.  At the water's edge is a small half moon of pebbles...blue, green and brown...flanked by reeds and cattails.  To the north you can see a small footbridge crossing the creek.  Tied to a limb of a tall oak tree is a length of hempen rope.

title: [River's Rest, East River Beach]
description: Swift and narrow, the North River rushes madly from east to west.  It is just wide enough that jumping it would likely lead to a quick trip to the bay visible downstream.  From this point, you can see that the brambles extend to the river, overhanging the river bank, their branches dipping into the water.  Stone outcroppings break through to the surface of the thicket and a small lizard sleeps in the moonlight on the flat surface of the largest one.

Swift and narrow, the North River rushes madly from east to west.  It is just wide enough that jumping it would likely lead to a quick trip to the bay visible downstream.  From this point, you can see that the brambles extend to the river, overhanging the river bank, their branches dipping into the water.  Stone outcroppings break through to the surface of the thicket and a small lizard suns itself on the flat surface of the largest one.

title: [River Tunnels, Bramble Cave]
description: This mysterious cavern appears to have been purposefully crafted and carefully hidden by the growing brambles.  What little moonlight makes it through the brambles creates shifting and unsettling shadows on the walls, the dripping of water creating an odd accompaniment which seems to coincide with the shifting shadows.  In the shadows, you notice a small tunnel leading down steeply.

This mysterious cavern appears to have been purposefully crafted and carefully hidden by the growing brambles.  What little light makes it through the brambles creates shifting and unsettling shadows on the walls, the dripping of water creating an odd accompaniment which seems to coincide with the shifting shadows.  In the shadows, you notice a small tunnel leading down steeply.

title: [Krol Ship, Hold, Casks]
description: You find yourself precariously balanced atop a stack of several large casks, but well within reach of the cargo grate above you.

title: [Krol Ship, Main Deck Amidships]
description: This is the center of the ship, where the Krolvin load their cargo and move on and off the ship via the gangplank.  To the north, towards the stern, you can see the massive base of the mainmast.  Further aft is the quarterdeck.  Forward from here are the foremast trunk and the forecastle.

title: [Krol Ship, Forecastle]
description: The deck here is elevated from the main deck to provide a tactical advantage to the sailors during boardings.  From here most of the river can be viewed, as well as most of the cove to the south.

title: [Krol Ship, Bowsprit]
description: Tenuously you cling to the large spar here which extends out from the bow of the ship.  Below you the water from a small river flows past the anchor chain and into the cove with a constant gurgle.  It looks as though the only way to go is back down the bowsprit, but you may be able to climb down the anchor chain with care.

title: [Krol Ship, Bowsprit]
description: Tenuously you cling to the large spar here which extends out from the bow of the ship.  Below you the water from a small river flows past the anchor chain and into the cove with a constant gurgle.  It looks as though the only way to go is back down the bowsprit, but you may be able to climb down the anchor chain with care.

title: [Krol Ship, Anchor Chain]
description: You are holding on to the wet anchor chain with the greatest of care, fully aware of the water swirling under the ship, below you.  Although the bowsprit is not high above you, trying to climb up to it would be suicide.  A few feet above you, the chain disappears into the ship's hull through the hawse hole.  You may be able to squeeze through it.

title: [Zoo, Storage Room]
description: The room is barren except for a pile of blankets in the corner.  The thick dust is criss-cossed with footprints.

title: [Zoo, Fox Cage]
description: A clean-picked fox skeleton lies in the back corner of this cage.  Aside from the small wooden box that was once its den, the cage is barren.

title: [Alchemist, Ruined Balcony]
description: Only a narrow ledge still remains of the former balcony.  This vantage provides an excellent view of the overgrown courtyard and the decrepit buildings beyond the crumbling perimeter walls.  Twenty feet below the ledge, slate tiles and shattered pots record the rest of the balcony's demise.  With some care, it might be possible to climb down the wall, but a heap of jaggedly splintered support beams awaits anyone with more confidence than skill.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: By night, the dominant hues of the courtyard are the delicate silver of reflected moonlight and the greenish-black of shadowy leaves.  Crumbling walls border the courtyard, demarcating the line between an untended interior and an equally wild exterior.  Broken slate tiles and shattered pots litter the ground around the remains of a fallen balcony.  A single shaft of moonlight pierces a jagged crack in the building's wall, but darkness dominates whatever lies beyond.

Crumbling walls border the courtyard, demarcating the line between an untended interior and an equally wild exterior.  Broken slate tiles and shattered pots litter the ground around the remains of a fallen balcony.  Part of the building's interior may be glimpsed through a jagged crack in the wall, seeming shadowy and dim by contrast with the brilliant orchids and verdant leaves that fill the overgrown garden.

title: [Bridge]
description: From here you can see the ravine below as it runs east-west beneath you.  The main doors to the Citadel stand on the northern ledge from here.  Wind howls by threatening to toss you off the bridge, making you feel a bit nervous.

title: [Outside Citadel]
description: To the south in the ravine, you see a odd contraption that looks like half of a bridge, there are levers and weights and gears and pulleys.  You also stand next to the mighty doors to the Citadel.

title: [Millah's Fen, Cold Stream]
description: The cobbled ruins of a road emerge from the cold stream and lead up to a nearby stream bank, the only opening in the two walls of massive reeds that constrain the stream to its pathway.  The water is clear but deep, allowing for the passage of dark, unknowns slipping through the water from shadow to shadow.

title: [Millah's Fens, Stream Bank]
description: The remnants of a stone road emerge from the narrow pathway leading to the southwest, only to disappear once again into the waters of a cold, languid stream.  Cutting its way through the tall surrounding wall of reeds, the stream disappears to the north, while dispersing into several fast moving rivulets to the south.  Dark, elongated shapes move beneath the surface of the water, vanishing and emerging from shadows in the stream.

title: [Millah's Fen, Cold Stream]
description: A ruined cobbled road rises from the waters of the cold stream and ascends a nearby stream bank.  The tall reeds give way to smaller reeds and grasses that overwhelm the stream and prevent any further passage north.  A gnarled sycamore bends over the stream with pale white limbs draped in hanging moss.

title: [Millah's Fen, Stream Bank]
description: The remnants of a cobbled stone road emerge from a wide stream and climb over the bank in the direction of a rocky hill.  The hill stands tall and alone, its rock-strewn sides covered in moss and patches of brown grass, rising out of the patchy fog, oblivious to the surrounding flat fens and marshes.  Pale, gnarled sycamores bend over the stream and surround the area with moss-draped ghostly white forms.

title: [Marsh Keep, East Wall]
description: Ending abruptly to the south, the wall continues to the north toward the end of the eastern side of the fortification.  The narrow pathway continues along the same basic direction, skirting away from the wall where the earth has given way to a gaping hole in the ground.  Footprints, none of them from the civilized races, lead in and out of the hole and down into the nearby fens.

title: [Marsh Keep, Dungeon Cell]
description: Rubble fills most of the cell from the collapse of the eastern wall of the room.  Light flickers in from outside the doorway, dimly reflected off the surfaces of chains and manacles still attached to the unaffected walls.  Piled near to the door are mounds of discarded clothes, most torn and shredded.

title: [Marsh Keep, Grand Hall]
description: A draft slowly swings a large candelabra above back and forth over on the other side of the great hall, directly above a wide, black hole set in the middle of the floor.  Dark stains trail from a large examining table over the stone floor to the edge of the hole, from which emanates a rank odor.  Separating this area from the one to the south are a row of bookshelves brimming with tomes, scrolls, and odd artifacts.

title: [Marsh Keep, Dungeon Cell]
description: The partial skeleton of a troll hangs from a pair of manacles bolted to the wall of the small damp cell.  Discarded bones lie beneath the skeleton and scattered across the floor, next to a pile of rotting skins, hides, and even more bones.  A dark green moss covers much of the wall opposite the door, filling the room with the smell of earth, and a cold dampness that lingers in the air fails to overpower the stench of decomposition emanating from the pile.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Basilica Plaza]
description: To the east a series of wide stone steps lead up the side of a pyramid.  A palatial building awaits at the top of the stairs, towering above the ruins of the surrounding city.  In the river to the west, partially submerged in the water, can be seen a carved obsidian statue fashioned in the image of a massive warrior.  The tip of a thick obsidian spear rests among the bulrush growing along the edge of the river bank.

title: [Basilica Platform, First Level]
description: The irregular shadows of night darkened ruins spread out to the west of the pyramid.  Wide stone steps lead down to the streets below.  Another set of steps lead up to the second level of the pyramid.

Positioned above all the single story buildings of the city, it is possible to see the damage that time has wrought.  Several blocks to the northwest a tall, dark tower pokes its tip above the cracked and crumbling walls of the surrounding structures.  Wide stone steps lead down to the streets below.  Another set of steps lead up to the second level of the pyramid.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Amphitheater]
description: Grass grows in rich abundance across this open field, spreading out in every direction in rippled waves of gold and green.  A series of terraced benches rises to the west.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Basilica Plaza]
description: A wide aisle runs between the pyramid and tiers of stone benches arranged in an oval pattern around an open space to the east.  Here and there, a small sapling has broken through the paved surface between the benches, like potted plants perched on a sitting room shelf.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Amphitheater]
description: Grass grows in rich abundance across this open field, spreading out in every direction in rippled waves of gold and green.  A series of terraced benches rises to the west.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, south

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Basilica Plaza]
description: A series of stone benches circles out and around a large oval space to the east.  A section of the tiered seats is toppled over at the northern end of the oval, breaking the perfect symmetry of the structure and forming a wall along the edge of the river.

title: [Basilica Platform, Second Level]
description: The irregular shadows of night darkened ruins spread out to the east of the pyramid.  Wide stone steps lead down to the platform below.  Another set of steps lead up to the third level of the pyramid.

From this lofty height it is possible to see the dense forest to the east of the city walls.  Wide stone steps lead down to the streets below.  Another set of steps lead up to the third level of the pyramid.

title: [Basilica Platform, Third Level]
description: A building constructed of gleaming white marble is enthroned upon the pinnacle of the pyramid.  No vegetation climbs the pristine heights of the exterior walls. No dirt or signs of erosion mar the ornate carvings that surround the arched entrance leading into its massive hall. It is as if time has come to halt atop this lofty tower.  Wide stone steps lead down to the platform below.

title: [Aftcastle Companionway]
description: Black walnut wainscotting below silvery haon paneling lines this hallway.  The aftcastle door is at one end of this companionway, with the gold inlaid black walnut door of the Captain's cabin filling the other.  A heavily grained monir door in the starboard bulkhead bears the Master's plaque, while ashwood and oak doors in the port bulkhead are marked with the Pilot's and First Mate's plaques.

title: [Glaesen Star, 1st Mate's Cabin]
description: Little more than a closet with a bunk and a sea chest in it, still it does afford some privacy for the ship's first officer.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: A set of descending stairs leads to the northwest, toward the center of the ruins.  Two marble pillars, seemingly in good condition, support the ceiling and form an archway in the southern wall.  The strong smell of the sea is carried in by a breeze that swirls, almost violently, through a window along the eastern wall.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: Aside from the water that has flooded the area, the room is plain.  A single iron sconce remains attached to the wall, and the remains of another rests below the surface of the water.

title: [Hearthstone, Balcony]
description: Lining the edge of this balcony, which overlooks the main lobby below, a polished oak railing glows in the soft moonlight emanating through windows high on the southern wall of the lobby.  Rich burgundy carpet underfoot softens the echo of voices drifting on the air.  To the east a fieldstone staircase curves down out of view, an alcove tucked into the wall at the top step.

Lining the edge of this balcony, which overlooks the main lobby below, a polished oak railing gleams in the warm sunlight streaming through windows high on the southern wall of the lobby.  Rich burgundy carpet underfoot softens the echo of voices drifting on the air.  To the east a fieldstone staircase curves down out of view, an alcove tucked into the wall at the top step.

title: [Hearthstone, Guest Room]
description: Comfortably furnished, this guest room is a small suite in itself.  Rich burgundy carpet and curtains are highlighted by the white plastered walls.  A large canopied bed rests against the west wall, covered with a quilted coverlet and a ruffled bed-skirt.  A small writing desk rests on the north wall complete with lightly scented note paper, an ink-well and a quill pen.  At the window, two comfortable chairs sit next to a small table with a small bouquet of fragrant herbs freshening the air.

title: [Ta'Illistim Gaol, Vestibule]
description: More glass cases line the walls in this small room.  A few benches devoid of any cushioning serve as uncomfortable resting places for those waiting for an audience with the city guardsmen.  A heavy tanik door stenciled with a crescent moon over an eight-pointed star leads into an office, and on the opposite wall is a set of sturdy brass-bound oak doors.  A massive glaes portcullis leads into the prison proper, while a black basalt archway opens into the entry hall.

title: [Ta'Illistim Gaol, Armory]
description: Hardly larger than an ample closet, this stone-walled room serves as the armory for the prison guards.  Lining one wall is a large rack filled with various polearms and a smaller, more elaborate rack holding an assortment of swords of obvious elven make.  A rack of axes, both fantastical and functional, rests near a set of heavy brass-bound oak doors.  The weapons are held in the racks by thick iron bars, each secured with a large lock.  Chain shirts and shields hang from hooks on the walls, serving as martial wallpaper.

title: [Shimmarglin Inn, East Hall]
description: Thick red carpet coats the wooden flooring, muffling the sound of heavy footfalls as patrons pass through the hallway.  Glowing orbs, perhaps the size of a clenched fist, illuminate the corridor at ten-foot intervals.  The sharp scent of wood polish lingers in the air.

title: [Red Bear Room]
description: Walls of dark granite paneled in polished redwood encase this simple yet austere chamber.  A large tapestry depicting a charging red bear hangs along one wall, opposite a softly roaring hearth.  The musky scent of burning wood clings to the air in the room, mixing with the sweet scent of rose petals rising from a bowl atop a small table.  An elegant bed of highly polished wood lies near the center of the room, its deep crimson linen snugly tucked.

title: [Shimmarglin Inn, East Hall]
description: Plush red carpeting runs east to west through the hallway, its crimson hue highlighted by the steady glow of glass orbs set within silver sconces on the walls.  Silence fills the passage, the activities of guests masked behind the sturdy oak doors leading to private rooms.

title: [Black Oak Room]
description: Walls of dark granite encase this simple yet austere chamber.  A large tapestry depicting an ancient black oak hangs along one wall, opposite a roaring hearth.  The musky scent of burning wood clings to the air in the room, mixing with the fresh scent of pine rising from a bowl atop a small table.  An elegant bed of highly polished wood lies near the center of the room, its somber green linen snugly tucked.

title: [Shimmarglin Inn, East Hall]
description: The hallway ends here before a large stained glass window.  A pale glow filters through the heavily tinted glass, sending weak shafts of light across the red carpeting.  Miniscule flakes of dust twirl slowly in the dim rays of light.

title: [Timber Wolf Room]
description: Walls of dark granite paneled in polished redwood encase this simple yet austere chamber.  A large tapestry depicting a snarling timber wolf hangs along one wall, opposite a warm hearth.  The musky scent of burning wood clings to the air in the room, mixing with the sweet scent of jasmine rising from a bowl atop a small table.  An elegant bed of highly polished wood lies near the center of the room, its dark brown linen snugly tucked.

title: [Solhaven Inn, Upstairs Hall]
description: Brass sconces on either wall light this red carpeted hall.  An incredibly ugly vase sits on a table along the north wall.  Upon the south wall is a hanging depicting the founding of Solhaven.  A wide marble staircase leads to the lower floor of the inn.

title: [Solhaven Inn, Emerald Room]
description: Sheer emerald green curtains drape along the sides of the four poster bed covered with a matching spread and plump pillows.  Vultite shaded oil-lit lamps shed their light upon a dark monir table and chairs by a window.  A marble fireplace carved with fanciful sprites fills one wall and adds warmth to the room.

title: [Captain's Rest, Hallway]
description: Well-polished brass lamps cast light upon the modwir-paneled walls and blue carpeting.  In one corner a large potted plant sits in a brass planter.  Upon the one wall without a door, a collection of cutlasses hangs, ranging in size from a blade small enough for a child to hold, to one so large a giantman would have difficulty holding it.

title: [Captain's Rest, Compass Room]
description: A spacious four poster bed covered with a blue and green comforter sits across from a fireplace.  The mantle of the fireplace seems to be made of a large piece of driftwood.  Upon this mantle sits a highly polished, vultite cased, ship's compass.  A polished oaken table with a mithril inlay of the compass points sits under the open window.

title: [Tropics Trail, Exit]
description: A shadowy archway in the rock wall reveals a narrow stairway that has been cut through the rock, spiraling down towards the entrance of the aviary.  Clusters of pale lavender spider lilies, their angular petals edged in a vivid amethyst, grow at the base of the archway.  Lacy networks of vines drape across the face of the rock, displaying showy white and yellow striped morning glories.

title: [Aviaries, Entrance]
description: A long stone ramp leads down into a glass-domed enclosure, the stacked slate walls rising to support the clear, curving roof.  Bird tracks of various sizes and shapes are inlaid into the floor, wandering along a path that leads deeper into the structure.  A squat, tilted bronze-faced sign is placed near a set of wide double doors that lead out.

title: [Temple of Tonis, Main Hall]
description: Walls painted a shade of blue like that of a summer sky adrift with wispy clouds surround this rotunda.  The detail is so exact and refined that when combined with the wavering light from a row of tiny windows, shadows deepen and highlights change, giving the illusion of movement.  Were it not for the four white marble columns that meet the ceiling in bracing arches, the setting could be in the heavens.  Towards the back wall, a lapis lazuli altar is balanced on the wings of three golden pegasi.

title: [Temple of Tonis, Eastern Apse]
description: On a small, square dais covered with a rug of azure velvet sits a massive ornate throne carved from mahogany.  The headrest is fashioned into a golden crown set with sparkling jewels of all hues, and the wide armrails are crafted to resemble ornate treasure chests.  A semi-circle of smaller, similar thrones face the platform, though the atmosphere is more of brotherhood than worship.

title: [Gypsy Compound, Kitchen]
description: Open on two sides, the kitchen is supported by wooden posts and sports a polished oak floor.  Large and small river stones form the other two walls, one of which is fitted with enormous baking ovens and a large hearth.  An enormous dining table, surrounded by a motley assortment of oak benches, stands at the center of the room beneath a candelabrum of frosted sea glass globes.  Near the rear of the room is a single oak door that is flanked by glass-front cabinets, while at the front is a set of steps.

title: [Gypsy Compound, Pond]
description: High grasses wave gently in the light breeze that travels through the area, their slender tips dipping to touch the riverstone path that leads away from the pond's edge.  Enormous lily pads speckle the pond, which is teeming with a variety of fish that can be glimpsed beneath the clear waters.  A pair of benches is set to the right of the shore and frame a pair of steps leading into an open front kitchen, while a low clothesline rests opposite them airing various articles of clothing.

title: [Manor House, Second Floor]
description: Unusually dark due to the double layer of boards that have been nailed over the windows, the floor and walls of the corridor appear to be in very good shape aside from a layer of dirt and the usual cobwebs.  The hallway ends at a haon framed doorway, and two doors -- one of oak and another of yew -- are evenly spaced along the corridor's east wall.

title: [Manor House, Study]
description: Devoid of furniture, it's unclear how this room was originally used.  From its size and the lack of windows it was probably either a study or servants' quarters.

title: [Museum Member's Suite]
[Museum, Member Lounge]
description: This reception area is restricted to use by members, patrons, donors and the elite of Wehnimer's Landing, to gather and entertain like-minded culture mavens.  The marble floors and walls are highly polished, reflecting the limpid light that filters through the stained glass skylight overhead.

In the middle of the ceiling, a large crystal chandelier descends to illuminate the inlaid wooden dance floor in the center of the room.  Various stained glass skylights dot the ceiling in an artfully haphazard fashion, each one a different scene of upper class society.  Along the northern wood-paneled wall, a long cloth-covered table is laden with refreshments.  Against the opposite wall, several plush velvet settees rest on the green marbled flooring that runs the edge of the room, offset from an intricately patterned silk curtain in the corner.

title: [Hall of Knowledge, Library]
description: Bookshelves encompass all the remaining wall space that is not taken up by doors, and a plush pale gold rug covers the floor.  Wooden tables, flickering oil lanterns set on their surfaces, and cushioned chairs offer areas to spread out and read or study.  Scents of parchment, glue, and dust permeate the room.  The well-manicured librarian stands behind a low wooden checkout desk, its surface littered with folios, quills, and jars of ink.

title: [Outpost Tunnel]
description: The warm air hangs still in this subterranean corridor, surrounded by the hill on all sides.  Torches mounted along the walls merely illuminate the way, as there are no decorations or furniture to cast their light on.  The tunnel forks, leading toward a tall stone door to the northeast and a square stone door to the northwest.  A round steel hatch claims an unusual place in the tunnel's ceiling.

title: [Outer Courtyard]
description: This raised stone plateau offers a panoramic view of the wilds of Teras Isle.  The Eye of V'Tull stands sentry over the trees of Greymist, the Fhorian Village, and the gates of the town of Kharam Dzu proper.  A round steel hatch leads down through the stone floor.

title: [Meeting Hall, Amphitheater]
description: This underground structure is impressive in its sheer size.  Nearly twenty levels comprise the seating area, each level having seating for hundreds.  A small podium, dwarf-sized, resides on a modest stone platform at the lowest level of the room.

title: [Meeting Hall, Ramp]
description: The tunnel flares wide as it opens into another room at the bottom.  The handrails curl around into the new room for a few feet before looping into a circle and ending.  More low-hanging lanterns line the entryway, kept constantly in motion from too many close encounters with heads.

title: [Arboretum, Middle of the Stream]
description: This large rock is flat and dry, providing a nice place to stop and rest midstream.  The brook rushes quickly past on both sides, foaming white around the edges of this perch.  A small pool forms on the downstream side of the rock with an occasional fish darting through the cool green depths.  The musical sound of water cascading over stones combines with the song of nearby birds to create a forest melody.

title: [Arboretum, Stream Bank]
description: The trail ends abruptly at the edge of a swift stream.  Lichen-covered granite lines the bank, and mossy round stones can be seen under the water.  The brook foams white where it passes around obstacles and is crystal clear in the small pools and eddies.  Moonlight streams through the trees, reflecting off the creek with a silvery brilliance.

The trail ends abruptly at the edge of a swift stream.  Lichen-covered granite lines the bank, and mossy round stones can be seen under the water.  The brook foams white where it passes around obstacles and is crystal clear in the small pools and eddies.  Sunlight streams through the trees, reflecting off the creek with a bright glare.

title: [Arboretum, Middle of the Stream]
description: This large rock is flat and dry, providing a nice place to stop and rest midstream.  The brook rushes quickly past on both sides, foaming white around the edges of this perch.  A small pool forms on the downstream side of the rock with an occasional fish darting through the cool green depths.  The musical sound of water cascading over stones combines with the song of nearby birds to create a forest melody.

title: [Remembrance Ridge, Stream Bank]
description: Leaves blanket the ground, creating a slippery climb up a steep hillside, leading to the peak of a ridge.  Low branches extend out, serving as handholds for traversing the slope as the minimal path winds between fallen boulders and trees.  A swift stream rushes along its channel at the base of the rise.

title: [Small Cottage, Quiet Pool]
description: You find the water of this quiet pool suprisingly warm, and at its deepest point no more than about six feet.  The water is just clear enough for you to see the sandy bottom, and a number of small but colorful fish in the pool with you.  At the far end is a small shallow area covered with lily pads, many in full bloom, their white and pink blossoms imparting a refreshing fragrance to the air around you.

title: [Small Cottage, Courtyard]
description: Thick woods surround this courtyard, extending a feeling of security and tranquility.  An outdoor grill made of clay bricks sits to one side, and several modwir chairs sit around a table on the other.  A varied assortment of relaxing sounds drifts in from the woods, and the quiet pool just a short distance out from the cottage.  You find yourself thinking how wonderful it would be to just come here and relax at the end of the day.

title: [Wehnimer's Museum, Rooftop]
description: The view from the rooftop extends all the way to the walls of Wehnimer's Landing and beyond.  Exposed to the elements, this wind blown edifice juts up into the sky opposite the observatory tower on the eastern side of the museum.  Protected from errant footfalls by metal rims, various stained glass skylights are set into the rough stone floor.  An unobtrusive drainpipe is attached to the side of the building, leading rainwater away from the roof.

title: [Wehnimer's, Wisraith Lane]
description: Interspersed among the small shops along the cobbled road are a few modwir-shingled private houses.  They are gaily decorated, competing for individuality with one another by means of daubs of colorful paint, skillfully carved doors and shutters, and window boxes bursting with ornamental flowers and fresh herbs.  A bright yellow awning lit by a glowing lamp marks the entrance to the florist, whose windows are brimming with fresh blossoms.

Interspersed among the small businesses and shops along the cobbled road are a few modwir-shingled private houses.  They are gaily decorated, competing for individuality with one another by means of daubs of colorful paint, skillfully carved doors and shutters, and window boxes bursting with ornamental flowers and fresh herbs.  A bright yellow awning marks the entrance to the florist, whose windows are brimming with fresh blossoms.

title: [Icewall Penitentiary, Bridge]
description: Four sections of iron-shod rope, each consisting of several lengths wound around another, offer dire passage over an ensured death below.  From an icy ledge to the east, the plankless bridge extends over the chasm and has been securely tethered to both sides of a circular opening to the west.  Hooded iron sconces offer limited torchlight on either end of the bridge.

title: [Icewall Penitentiary, Ledge]
description: The guards at the top of an imflass-chain ladder stamp their feet in a vain attempt to fight off the biting cold.  A single torch set in an unadorned iron sconce provides only scarce light, causing shadows to flitter about the area.  Near the torch, a thick imflass door has been fixed securely into the ice and bears a prominent mithril plaque.  To the west, a suspended rope bridge crosses a narrow chasm.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Ledges]
description: The ledge winds around a niche in the cliffs, the shacks set among the rocks somewhat sheltered from the constant wind by the curve of the land.  Weathered trees line the edge of the cliff above, their branches swept back over the merchant road.  A steep trail leads down the cliffside.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Rocky Slope]
description: A niche in the cliffs shelters a sloping field of scattered rocks and dry brush.  Grasses rustle in the constant wind sweeping in from the bay, and seabirds soar overhead, their plaintive cries echoing from the cliffs.  A steep trail winds up the cliffside between the rocks.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Overhang]
description: This huge outcropping of stone hangs out over the precarious ledges below.  A few gnarled trees have found enough dirt to take root near the dark mouth of a cave set into the cliff, from which emanates a somewhat acrid odor and a faint sound of fluttering wings.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Cave]
description: The rough, shadowy cave smells of musk and sea air.  Lining the stalactite-riddled ceiling are an uncountable number of bats, their small furred bodies crowded together for warmth and companionship.  Thousands of beady black eyes stare down at you, shining in the low light.

title: [Beacon Hall, Dragon Fountain]
description: An enormous stone dragon's head emerges from the dark center of a large hole, dominating this round chamber.  Water pours out of the dragon's gaping maw, creating a swift waterfall that empties into the hole below.

title: [Beacon Hall, Water Lagoon]
description: The hole from which the waterfall emerges is far, far above.  Providing the only source of outside light, the opening frames the noble head of the immense stone dragon that is barely visible above.  The dragon's scaled body glistens under the fine mist from the waterfall, and its majestic wings stretch out against the walls of this cavern.  The large, powerful legs of the creature disappear beneath the rippled surface of the lagoon.

title: [Beacon Hall, Dock]
description: A well-built stone pier juts out into the bay at the foot of a long stairway carved from the face of the cliff.

title: [Beacon Hall, Rock Room]
description: This room appears to be unfinished.  Although it is encompassed on all four sides by stone walls, it lacks a ceiling, and sunlight streams in unhindered.  The floor is made up entirely of small rocks and pebbles, which crunch loudly underfoot.

title: [Underground Tunnel]
description: The passage rises and narrows in the pitch darkness into a small, hollowed-out dead end.  Feeling around in the niche, you can make out the outlines of a small wooden trapdoor in the roof of the tunnel.

title: [Pawn Shop, Backroom]
description: This backroom is where many of the items pawned are offered for resale.  On one wall a prominent sign reads, "Warning:  All items that are sold here are used merchandise and sold on an "as-is" basis with no guarantees and no refunds. -- Kilron".  A sales clerk stands nearby, ready to offer help with any purchases.

title: [Gypsy Compound, Library]
description: Brightly lit by the hundreds of candles that line the rafters, the small room is tidy and lined from floor to ceiling with shelves.  Each shelf holds a variety of items used for scrying, as well as several tomes of lore.  A simple desk is set in the center of the room and has a plush chair set behind it.  A quaint white oak door stands slightly ajar and leads to the Lore Circle, while a dark pine door leads to a small clearing at the back of the cottage.

title: [Gypsy Compound, Lore Circle]
description: Neatly trimmed grass surrounded by bright white riverstones creates a quiet clearing set between two pathways.  Enormous boulders worn smooth at their tops are set around a sea glass ring and covered with thick blankets for comfort.  A pair of copper lanterns are set into the support poles of a small cottage, while a slender track leads around behind.

title: [Manor House, Attic]
description: Cobwebs fill every corner of this attic, and dust, mold and bat droppings cover the floor.  Several holes in the roof allow moonlight into this part of the attic near the stairway leading up from the manor's second floor.

Cobwebs fill every corner of this attic, and dust, mold and bat droppings cover the floor.  Several holes in the roof allow sunlight into this part of the attic near the stairway leading up from the manor's second floor.

title: [Manor House, Servants' Stairs]
description: Along the east wall a stairway descends to the ground floor of the house, while another stairway along the south wall leads up to the manor's attic.  Both sets of stairs look weak, and a few of the steps are actually missing.

title: [Warrior Guild, Entry Courtyard]
description: A small, crystalline pool edged with profuse ferns and seasonal wildflowers offers a spot of serenity in the otherwise busy entrance to the guild proper.  Impressive in size and architectural detail, the fortress looms just ahead, while the manicured courtyard and outdoor areas beyond rest placidly in its grand shadow.  A slate walkway and well-defined paths meander further into the grounds.

title: [Illistim Warrior Guild, Foyer]
description: A grand, double staircase leads up to the administrative offices of the Warrior Guild of Ta'Illistim.  Mica-flecked blue granite floors lead to fine, maoral-paneled walls, each bedecked with a suit of armor.  To the east, the guild's distinctive task offices are plainly visible through a wide marble arch and easily accesible to all guild members.

title: [Isle Dyes, Courtyard]
description: Walled with heavy white canvas that plummets down in straight lines from the supporting poles, the dyeing area is large, wide, and airy.  The roof overhead is also made of canvas, though it is raised several feet higher than the walls on separate poles to allow sunlight to filter in.  Billowing in the passing breeze, light drapes, of a sheer white variety that is a lovely contraposition to the blue tile flooring, serve as dividers between the courtyard and the individual dyeing stalls.

title: [Isle Dyes, Foyer]
description: Reddish tiling spreads across the floor in pleasant contrast to the white stucco walls.  A trio of curving arches to the west open up into the showroom, while a simple arch to the north leads out into an open-air courtyard.  Just adjacent, a large bamboo desk has been commandeered by a massive collection of papers and half-full dye bottles.

title: [Smuggler's Tunnels, Wide Tunnel]
description: Nearly a cavern unto itself, the tunnel widens considerably into a large chamber illuminated by four torches set along its length.  Two alcoves have been cut into either side of the tunnel, one with stone steps leading upwards, and another with a ladder disappearing into the ceiling.  Somewhere in the darkness, crickets chirp contently.

title: [Targon's Tavern, Backroom]
description: The room is small by human standards, but the perfect size for a dwarf patron or barkeep.  Stacks of crates line one wall and rows of barrels line the other.  A light sprinkling of sand covers the floor on the far side of the room and trails off in the direction of the door leading back towards the bustling sounds of the tap room.  A stuffed rolton head hangs from one wall, an expression of shock and surprise eternally captured on its face.

title: [Smuggler's Tunnels, Wide Tunnel]
description: Nearly a cavern unto itself, the tunnel widens considerably into a large chamber illuminated by four torches set along its length.  Two alcoves have been cut into either side of the tunnel, one with stone steps leading upwards, and another with a ladder disappearing into the ceiling.  Somewhere in the darkness, crickets chirp contently.

title: [Timor's, House Annex Hallway]
description: The hallway floor is warped and uneven.  Ceramic oil lamps hang from the ceiling, bathing the hallway in a flickering light.

title: [Cleric Guild, River's Rest]
description: Onyx columns gleam in the light of myriad beeswax tapers which surround two central statues.  Each of the figures is cut from pale stone, as is the inscribed base on which they stand.  There are no windows, but the high arc of the domed ceiling keeps the chamber from feeling too enclosed.  An aged oak door is set between two onyx columns, and deep blue carpets, their patterns almost obscured by constellations of jasmine petals, muffle the steps of passing priests.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Cleric Guild, Library]
description: A narrow pool of ebon water bisects the library, an expansive room made more immense by the high, arched ceiling of dark crystal panes held in place by onyx and alabaster supports carved with symbols of the Arkati.  Tables and chairs cluster around the onyx-lined edges of the pool, and dozens of tall rosewood bookshelves overflowing with books fill the room.  The deep blue carpets are strewn with petals of lily, rose, and jasmine to add bright and fragrant counterpoints to the dark interior.

title: [Dark Tunnel]
description: Heavy footsteps can be heard overhead, along with deep, gruff voices.  Several empty crates have been stacked in the corner beside odd bits of metal.

title: [J.M. and Descendants, Foyer]
description: A small, entry room forms a T-shaped intersection with larger shops to the north and south.  Occasionally the sound of metal grinding on metal comes from either direction, and sometimes from both directions simultaneously.  Overhead, a large, tightly woven metal mesh cage houses a goodly number of fireflies, and their winking on and off illuminates the room with a soft strobe effect.  A metal sign affixed to the west wall offers a directory of services, and a heavy black door provides an exit.

title: [Rogue Guild, Roof]
description: A low wall encircles the roof affording a measure of privacy from anyone who happens to glance up.  Weeds and wildflowers growing in the cracks ruffle slightly in the breeze.

title: [Solhaven, Wentletrap Lane]
description: The buildings along this stretch of Wentletrap Lane are ornamented with a variety of sawtoothing, panelling and moldings, creating variety in a fairly conservative style.  A large, verdigrised brass quill hangs above the doorway of a small shop that occupies the northeast corner of the Scriveners' Hall.

title: [Wizard Guild, Steps]
description: The narrow channel feels as enclosed as a chimney and is almost as sooty.  The rock walls around you are uncomfortably warm to the touch, and the widely spaced torches shed little light on the seemingly never-ending steps.

title: [Annex, Dynamic Convergence]
description: With the appearance of having been created by a madman, no two walls in this odd chamber are the same height or length.  Splotches of gray paint in varying tones coat the walls unevenly, causing further disorientation.  As if this were not enough, a dizzying array of archaic runes has been scrawled across every flat surface, including the floor and ceiling.  Crooked doorways provide the only relief from this visual assault.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west, up, down

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Dark Chamber]
description: An acrid, sulfurous scent taints the air as thin tendrils of yellow-brown smoke rise from the glowing coals of an ornate iron brazier.  Dense mist merges with the smoke to obscure most of the room's dimensions and details, yet occasional swirls in the haze at floor level allow brief glimpses of a dark outline.

title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Cliff Top]
description: You are on a narrow ledge heading west.  The east side stops at a cliff which drops about 50 feet before the trail continues west again.

title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Staircase]
description: The trail up the mountain ends here at the base of a sheer, 50-foot cliff face.  In front of this is a series of four stone pillars that seems to be some sort of unusual staircase.  There are also some strange markings on the mountain wall.

title: [Small Cottage, Bedroom]
description: A beautiful crystal skylight provides the illumination to this cozy little bedroom and must provide an excellent view of the stars at night to anyone lying in the large, soft feather bed situated directly beneath it.  To one side sits an antique modwir nightstand accented in polished brass with a small mirror above.  A large, plush black bearskin rug takes up most of the remaining floorspace.

A beautiful crystal skylight provides an excellent view of the stars at night to anyone lying in the large, soft feather bed situated directly beneath it.  To one side sits an antique modwir nightstand accented in polished brass with a small mirror above.  A large, plush black bearskin rug takes up most of the remaining floorspace.

title: [Small Cottage, Courtyard]
description: Thick woods surround this courtyard, extending a feeling of security and tranquility.  An outdoor grill made of clay bricks sits to one side, and several modwir chairs sit around a table on the other.  A varied assortment of relaxing sounds drifts in from the woods, and the quiet pool just a short distance out from the cottage.  You find yourself thinking how wonderful it would be to just come here and relax at the end of the day.

title: [Saewehna Jungle, Lagoon]
description: Moonlight barely illuminates the murky depths of a vast lagoon stretching out before the tumble of water rushing down from the plateaus above.  The nocturnal melody of the jungle serves as a striking companion to the surprisingly quiet sound of the bi-level falls cascading from the lowest outcropping to feed the pool.  Deep shadows help to almost completely conceal the presence of a cave hidden behind the ripple of the liquid curtain.

A vast lagoon of brilliant blue depths stretches out before the tumble of water rushing down from the plateaus above.  The bi-level falls are surprisingly quiet as the water cascades from its lowest outcropping to feed the pool, and the ripple of the liquid curtain only partially conceals the shadows of a cave beneath the ledge.  Plumes of mist rise into the air constantly, casting glistening dew upon everything within close proximity.
from.location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Saewehna Jungle, Cave]
description: Lapping effortlessly at the moss and algae enshrouded walls of the enclosure, the murky water ripples lazily in ebbs and surges.  Dusky shadows within the cave enhance the absolute darkness of the night outside, and the hushed music of nocturnal creatures accompanies the melodic sounds of the falls in the background.

Lapping effortlessly at the moss and algae enshrouded walls of the enclosure, the vividly hued water ripples lazily in ebbs and surges.  The dusky shadows of the cave afford a buffer to the sun, and the hushed music of the falls provides a soothing background.
to.location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Saewehna Jungle, Clearing]
description: Reaching over the tufted grass clearing, an enormous banyan tree looms over a sleepy tortoise.  Centered in the surrounding vegetation, the banyan tree's roots bow outwards creating a barely noticeable dark hollow.  Reflecting the muted moonlight, bleached bones stand out against the darkened shadows in the clearing.  Highlighted by a stray moonbeam, a single fiery red lily rises up from the pile of bones.

Reaching over the tufted grass clearing, an enormous banyan tree offers a shady respite for a sleepy tortoise.  Centered in the surrounding vegetation, the banyan tree's roots bow outward creating a small, dark hollow.  Reflecting the bright sunlight, bleached bones stand out against the verdant grass and beige topsoil.  Adding a small splash of color, a single fiery red lily rises up from the pile of bones.
from.location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Saewehna Jungle, Mushroom Bed]
description: The maze of trees begins to thin, though the canopy of leaves still blots out much of the moonlight.  Normally sturdy, the soil increasingly becomes waterlogged toward the east, the muddy conditions making travel difficult.  As the atmosphere becomes dank, the vividly hued flowers make way for more subdued fungi and mosses.  Clustering around the base of one of the larger trees, a number of pale white mushrooms brighten the area.
to.location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Channel]
description: The passage slowly curves and leads to a rusted iron ladder that leads back up.  Something heavy must have fallen from above, as the cobblestones at the base of the ladder are cracked badly.

title: [Inn]
description: Quite a contrast from the squalor of the tunnels below, this comfortable common room looks well-furnished.  Several tables and chairs allow folks a comfortable place to sit and chat.  Large portraits adorn the walls, most depicting the more famous buildings of Ta'Vaalor.

title: [Unknown]
description: Thousands of undead move past, slowly advancing toward an outnumbered band of elven defenders perched atop a far off rise.  A lone figure in black behind the undead horde stands with arms upraised, urging the army forward relentlessly.  Streaks of lightning flash constantly among the roiling dark clouds above, leaving slowly fading crimson trails.  The land is parched and dead with innumerable cracks running through the barren ground and around the boulders.  No senses other than sight seem to function.

title: [Summoning Chamber]
description: Thick, woody, dark green vines make up the walls, floor and ceiling of this misshapen chamber.  Weak shafts of sunlight squeeze their way between the vines to dimly illuminate the area.  Blackened tendrils pulse and writhe on the floor as sparkling discharges of crimson energy keep time to a distant heartbeat, racing along the tendrils to converge in the center of the living floor.  The chamber sways and groans back and forth, as if it was high in a tree somewhere being buffeted by a brisk wind.

title: [Annex, Hallway]
description: Inlaid into the ruddy mahogany flooring of this broad corridor, bands of dark, medium, and light wood form paths to three exits set with stone of corresponding colors.  On the north side of the hallway, interlocking squares of white ash lead to a marble arch, and a strip of smokey-grey haon leads to a granite arch on the south side.  A line of dark ebonwood separates the two, terminating before the onyx-inlaid arch at the hall's west end.

title: [Annex, Equipment Room]
description: Considering the amount of cleaning equipment stored here, one might expect a great deal of dust and disarray, yet not a single item seems out of place.  A stout open-front locker holds brooms, dust pans, and other janitorial tools, each hung or stacked neatly within.  Along each wall of the spacious room, equally sturdy lockers and cupboards store cauldrons, alembics, and large pieces of equipment.  Each item is carefully nestled in its own clearly labeled partition.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Warrior Guild]
description: The moat is a mere trickle under the bridge, its width no greater than the span of a dwarf's leap.  The sandy ground is held firm at the moat's edges by massive retainer stones of grey slate.

title: [Under the Moat]
description: Clouds of dust swirl about the narrow tunnel, its breadth barely enough to contain one body at a time.  Sharp pebbles and small pieces of slate litter the ground while thick dust obscures the view of what lies ahead.

title: [Under the Moat]
description: Clouds of dust swirl about the narrow tunnel, its breadth barely enough to contain one body at a time.  Sharp pebbles and small pieces of slate litter the ground while thick dust obscures the view of what lies ahead.

title: [Under the Moat]
description: Here the flying dust starts to give way to a damp and possibly even narrower space.  Tiny rivulets of brownish water ocassionally trickle in and puddle at the already muddy ground.  It is uncertain how much longer this dilapidated tunnel will hold before it collapses.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Alchemy Nexus]
description: Wind whips through the open air stone room, the scent of the sea thick in the air and accompanied by the sound of crashing waves.  Five platforms extend from the immediate area and beyond them in all directions lies an endless expanse of dark water.  A glimpse over the edge of the platform reveals its location atop a great stone tower anchored in the sea, hundreds of feet above the surface of the water.  In the center of the platform stands a pillar, behind which descends a staircase.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Magic Workroom]
description: Torches mounted on brass poles hazily illuminate this testing room.  The walls, ceiling and floor are made from planks of sanded birch, but the wet floor planks are spread half an inch apart, perhaps to let something pass between them.  Several small cages line the west wall, a large cage sits next to the east wall, and an open cage resides against the north wall.  The odor of drenched wood somewhat masks the lesser stench of animal ordure.

title: [Unknown]
description: A huge blood red sun shines malevolently over a cracked, dusty land.  A few bushes and scrub grasses fight for survival.  The remains of a large tree trunk stand just to the west, and a black hole looms to the east.  The landscape is dominated by hillocks of burnt ochre stone, and a stiff wind stirs the dust into heavy, tight cyclones.  The view wavers as if heat was rising from this purgatory, but nothing is felt, nor heard, nor smelled, nor tasted...only seen.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Tub Room]
description: Condensation drips from the ceiling and runs down the ironwood walls to disappear into a wide drain grate in the far corner, leaving the floor slick with moisture.  A spacious brass tub has been set into the ironwood plank floor, and hot water swirls and foams within.  A metal vat is securely bolted against the wall with a pipe and a chain hanging down just above the tub.

title: [Unknown]
description: The bustle of crowds making their way between secular centers of town that converge here carries people along with its momentum.  The granite and marble facade of the First Provincial Bank stands solidly, a strange-looking guard armed with pike and crossbow posted at the door.  A number of well-dressed reptiles congregate outside.  Dwarves, elves, halflings and humans move in the crowd, but there are also more snakelike creatures, gnomes and furry, catlike sorts, although no one seems to take notice.

title: [Summoning Chamber]
description: The room shifts and heaves, making it difficult to stay standing on the slick floor.  The $-13494M, floor, and ceiling contract and expand, stretching and then snapping back to form an irregular sphere.  The surfaces are mottled and hot, looking and feeling more like raw flesh than anything else.  Veins of glowing crimson liquid run down walls, under the surface, to enter a sucking wound in the center of the floor.  The liquid moves to the sound of a beating heart and barely illuminates the cramped chamber.

title: [Unknown]
description: Elven archers in the livery of Vaalor stand astride an enormous marble arch.  Their arrows target a bilious green airship, but each is vaporized by a dull grey beam before reaching its target.  Below the aerial combat, hordes of animated orcs spew forth from a dark cavern, engaging in a vicious battle with two-headed centaurs defending a hillock of ice topped by an obsidian plinth.

title: [Lunule Weald, Zelia's Shrine]
description: Worms and insects ooze out of the dirt walls and creep along the floor in this small, squat chamber.  In the center of the chamber is a circle of black rocks, the top of each rock is painted with a silver crescent moon.  Inside the circle of rocks sits a stone sculpture of a woman with wild hair driving a chariot pulled by four stallions.  Moonlight streams in from the opening in the short ceiling, striking the sculpture and casting the shadow of a wild-haired woman on the dirt walls.

Worms and insects ooze out of the dirt walls and creep along the floor in this small, squat chamber.  In the center of the chamber is a circle of black rocks, the top of each rock is painted with a silver crescent moon.  Inside the circle of rocks sits a stone sculpture of a woman with wild hair driving a chariot pulled by four stallions.  Light streams in from the opening in the short ceiling, striking the sculpture and casting the shadow of a wild-haired woman on the dirt walls.

title: [Rustaye's Good Weapons]
description: The air practically reeks of weapon oil, and every surface gleams with it -- not, judging from the state of the weaponry, that it was applied in time to do much good, but apparently Rustaye has a philosophical approach to things, or else perhaps he believes that any amount of damage can be concealed with sufficient grease.  An orange-tinged hatch on the east wall allows egress.

title: [Spitfire, Companionway]
description: The shallow hallway quickly widens to the north, giving access into 'tween deck compartments.  Anyone much taller than a halfling is almost immediately endangered by the dropped ceiling of deckbeams, which begins at the entrance of the 'tween deck dining saloon.

title: [Stashers and Slashers, Foyer]
description: Dark wood paneling lines the walls of the foyer, offset by bright white porcelain plates affixed firmly to the wall by steel bracketing and lit by candle-filled lamps dangling overhead.  Standing against the wall opposite the open stained-glass hatch is a tufted brown leather couch, which is flanked on either side by low wooden endtables.

title: [Spitfire, Cargo Hold]
description: Water barrels, wine barrels, bales of cotton -- all sorts of cargo make up the walls of the aisle.  From supporting timbers spaced at regular intervals, lanterns sway gently in response to the calm waters of the harbor.  The bulkhead intersects the passageway, making it dogleg to the north.

title: [Spitfire, Fur Closet]
description: It is much colder in this small closet than it is in the rest of the ship.  The cooler temperature is likely a boon to the lush fur garments hanging from the long wooden racks which rest against two of the walls and the compartmented display hanging from a third.  A series of shallow copper troughs filled with ground charcoal run around the baseboards of the room underneath the racks.  Light filters in from the opaque paper-shaded window of the steel hatch, providing just enough brightness to illuminate the closet.

title: [Spitfire, Cargo Hold]
description: Water barrels, wine barrels, bales of cotton -- all sorts of cargo make up the walls of the aisle.  From supporting timbers spaced at regular intervals, lanterns sway gently in response to the calm waters of the harbor.  The bulkhead intersects the passageway, making it dogleg to the north.

title: [Spitfire, Cargo Hold]
description: Water barrels, wine barrels, bales of cotton -- all sorts of cargo make up the walls of the aisle.  From supporting timbers spaced at regular intervals, lanterns sway gently in response to the calm waters of the harbor.  Between two of the beams, an alcove has been created by the stacked inventory.

title: [Sea Dogs Of War, Troops]
description: The tall, but cramped, musty room smells faintly of seaweed, fruit tarts, and rum.  A rigging line dangles from above, leading to a small crow's nest suspended by chains near the top of the room.  In one corner, among discarded bottles and jugs, is an enruned mithril chest, and in the opposite corner is a battered wooden coffer.  A small hatch has been cut into the side of the wall.

title: [Garthlan's Wares, Entry]
description: Plain wooden planks form the bulkheads of this room.  Several crates are piled up in the corners with any stray markings scratched or burned off hastily.  Oily smoke from a pair of lanterns provides dim lighting and more than a few shadows.  To the east and west small cramped corridors lined with boxes and bales lead away.

title: [Spitfire, Cargo Hold]
description: A large stack of crates, boxes and barrels blocks further progress, forcing the aisle to turn back upon itself.  From one of the larger barrels sitting to the side, a small flicker of light peeks out from cracks marring its wooden slats.

title: [Tropic Treasure, Tasty Retreat]
description: Deep blue paint speckled with green and white adorns the wooden floor, walls, and ceiling.  Faint silhouettes of leaves and tropical flowers frame the path to the south.

title: [Spitfire, Cargo Hold]
description: Water barrels, wine barrels, bales of cotton -- all sorts of cargo make up the walls of the aisle.  From supporting timbers spaced at regular intervals, lanterns sway gently in response to the calm waters of the harbor.  A couple of cabins are nestled among the stacks, with carved doors to give access.

title: [Glass Works, Front Room]
description: A splintered oak table and a heavy thanot counter rest along the far wall to either side of a painted black arch.  Tiny fragments of light reflect off the goods on the tables, appearing as stars on the black velvet that hangs off the ends of the glass panes above and covers the walls.  A wooden hatch leads back to the cargo hold.

title: [Spitfire, Cargo Hold]
description: Water barrels, wine barrels, bales of cotton -- all sorts of cargo make up the walls of the aisle.  From supporting timbers spaced at regular intervals, lanterns sway gently in response to the calm waters of the harbor.  A cabin is nestled among the stacks, with a carved door to give access.

title: [Treasure Hunt, Seaside]
description: The gentle sounds of waves breaking on a light-colored sand beach fill the air.  A series of small dunes dot the edge of the beach, marking the perimeter.  A cracked and aged wooden signpost leans haphazardly to one side, and the wall into which a hatch is set is a magnificent mural of a wide-open ocean dotted with white clouds.  Brilliant sunlight bombards the beach here through a portal cut into the ceiling.

title: [Spitfire, Cargo Hold]
description: Water barrels, wine barrels, bales of cotton -- all sorts of cargo make up the walls of the aisle.  From supporting timbers spaced at regular intervals, lanterns sway gently in response to the calm waters of the harbor.  A cabin is nestled among the stacks, with a carved door to give access.

title: [A Stick in Your Eye, Workshop]
description: Various chutes, pipes, and conduits open out into this room, conveying an occasional load of rubbish.  The floor is cleverly constructed of tightly spaced wood lattice, allowing the smaller bits to fall into the fetid bilgewater below while keeping the larger detritus available for sorting.  A frayed rope ladder dangles down from some unseen vantage overhead.

title: [A Stick in Your Eye, Landing]
description: You break your long journey upward at a small landing, hardly more than a few planks wide.  Great stacks of lumber surround you, the sweet smell of the freshly sawn boards a refreshing change from the dank sewer below.  A small breeze comes from somewhere nearby, though the source seems hidden.

title: [A Stick in Your Eye, Landing]
description: You break your long journey upward at a small landing, hardly more than a few planks wide.  Great stacks of lumber surround you, the sweet smell of the freshly sawn boards a refreshing change from the dank sewer below.  A small breeze comes from somewhere nearby, though the source seems hidden.

title: [A Stick in Your Eye, Entry]
description: The low space between the decks is here completely filled with piles of fresh-sawn lumber.  All manner of woods are here, neatly stacked and bound: mundane woods, like pale boxwood and black ebony, as well as rare magical woods, from grey hoarbeam to russet-toned ruic.

title: [Rogue Guild, Wine Cellar]
description: The dim light from a torch casts a flickering light over the murky room causing dancing shadows to play over a rack of dusty wine bottles sitting against one wall.  Two large wine casks on the opposite wall nearly fill the rest of the room.  Sitting in the center of the bare floor is a small table.

title: [Rogue Guild, Pantry]
description: A large set of shelves covers one wall, filled with cobwebs and dust-covered table settings.  An ornate wrought iron lantern broods over the room, casting a sickly glow through grimy glass panes.  The floor is curiously scratched in a pattern before the shelves.

title: [Eastern Harbor, Sandy Peninsula]
description: Golden sunlight warms the air, which is heavy and balmy from the rise and fall of the surf that separates the glittering sands of the beach from the roped-off swimming area.  Umbrellas dot the coast, their vibrant silken expanses offering shade to the blankets set beneath them.  Beach grass-riddled dunes create a barrier between the sprawling streets of the shopping district and the beach, while a sandy pathway accommodates the foot traffic.

Cool and misty, the air is dominated by the sound of the surf as it pounds against the sandy beach beneath the silvery light of the moons.  Passing clouds occasionally cast shadows upon the landscape and paint the various umbrellas lining the coast in caliginous hues.  Beach grass-riddled dunes create a barrier between the sprawling streets of the shopping district and the beach, while a sandy pathway accommodates the foot traffic.

title: [Eastern Harbor, Dolphin Lane]
description: Nestled within verdant dog rose bushes, a series of white benches fashioned of wooden slats lines the cobblestone streets amid pillars fitted with frosted globes.  Occupying a space along one of the sidewalks, a young freckled merchant offers treats from her umbrella-covered wooden cart, while to the east, a series of dunes topped with high, green beach grasses provides easy access to the beach.

Nestled within verdant dog rose bushes, a series of white benches fashioned of wooden slats lines the cobblestone streets amid pillars fitted with glowing frosted globes that cheerfully dispel the dark.  Occupying a space along one of the sidewalks, a young freckled merchant offers treats from her umbrella-covered wooden cart, while to the east, a series of dunes topped with high, green beach grasses provides easy access to the beach.

title: [Groom's Waiting Room]
description: Silver and ebon-veined marble tiles spread across the floor towards walls that are painted with scenes of the wild hunt.  Standing before a wide open window is a full-length mirror, while a glass-covered wrought iron table nearby houses a set of playing tiles.  Standing at opposite sides of the room, a set of polished linden stairs leads down into the ebon chapel, while a marble fauna-patterned staircase leads into the white chapel.

title: [Great Hall, Ebon Chapel]
description: Golden tiles mix with ebon as they stretch across the floor to meet with the linden walls that are accented with ebonwood columns that spiral upward to a sanguine dome ceiling.
