Wrought iron wall sconces ring the upper reaches of each carved support and are fitted with dark green, white, and pale yellow tallows, which spread golden illumination through the area.  An enormous stained glass window is the focal point beyond the ebon marble altar and is framed by twin alcoves, one lined in gold and the other lined in silver.

title: [Bride's Waiting Room]
description: White gossamer drapes flutter lazily in the light seaside breeze that drifts through the open birch windows that they frame and is accompanied by the spill of golden sunlight.  A full-length mirror stands beside a glass-covered wrought iron table that is covered with roses in nearly every hue of the rainbow and still has ample room for storage.  Standing at opposite sides of the room, a series of silvery ash stairs leads down into the ebon chapel, while a marble ivy-patterned staircase leads into the white chapel.

White gossamer drapes flutter lazily in the cool seaside breeze that drifts through the open birch windows and is accompanied by a spill of silvery moonlight.  A full-length mirror stands beside a glass-covered wrought iron table that is covered with roses in nearly every hue of the rainbow and still has ample room for storage.  Standing at opposite sides of the room, a series of silvery ash stairs leads down into the ebon chapel, while a marble ivy-patterned staircase leads into the white chapel.

title: [Great Hall, White Chapel]
description: Deep cobalt blue tiles stretch across the floor, their glossy expanses decorated with white trilliums that provide a delicate accent to the white walls and high ceiling.  Twin alcoves flank the altar, one trimmed in carved wildlife and the other in verdant ivy bands.  An enormous stained glass window in the shape of an inverted diamond occupies the back wall, its image that of a young couple gazing up at the sun as they kneel in prayer.

title: [Albatross, Belowdecks]
description: This cramped space holds a few ratty bunks.  An oil lamp swings from the ceiling and illuminates a work table where various needles and other instruments lay covered in a thin layer of dust.  Upon the walls are pictures drawn by some homesick sailor.  Some are of sea creatures and an old town, but most of them are of women.  A trapdoor above one bunk leads abovedecks.

title: [Albatross, Main Deck]
description: Sunlight glints off the polished rosewood and mahogany decks.  A heavy dark mahogany door banded with ornate gold filigree leads inside the riverboat, while the deck wraps about it all.  To the northwest, a large foredeck is visible, and to the aft, the large paddlewheel can be seen.  Carefully piled silk rope sits next to a gaily beribboned mahogany gangplank leading off the boat, an iron ring peeking through the layers.

title: [Stone Baths, Upstairs Hall]
description: Mahogany-hued carpeting runs the entire length of the hall, brightened by silvery moonlight streaming in through a large arched window.  A series of painted doors line each side of the walls, while at the end of the hallway a sturdy ladder leads up to a wooden hatch in the ceiling.

title: [Stone Baths, The Simple Oak]
description: Spacious and practical, the windowless room is illuminated by a myriad of candles resting upon tiered felwood shelving.  A large circular table dominates the center of the room and is surrounded by high-backed wooden chairs.  Light flickers on the plush plum carpeting and is reflected onto a comfy bed, nestled against paneled maple walls.  A glass-fronted solid oak dresser occupies the space beneath one of the shelves.

title: [Cholgar's Cavern]
description: The walls glisten as water slowly drips down, creating a musty aroma to the shadowy cavern.  Corroded black lanterns provide a soft diffused glow, faintly illuminating a cracked crystal fountain resting between a stack of old crates and a waterlogged bookcase.  A broken chain snakes around a cluster of tarnished bins which are positioned next to a pile of rubble.

title: [Theatre, Backstage]
description: The area behind the stage is in disarray, with wooden props scattered about the floor while fanciful costumes are overflowing from iron-bound chests.  Bins of old paint rest near a few discolored wooden sets, their transformation still incomplete.  A few stools rest before a row of vanities, and a dim passageway leads back to the theatre's auditorium.

title: [Hall of Knowledge, Library]
description: Bookshelves encompass all the remaining wall space that is not taken up by doors, and a plush pale gold rug covers the floor.  Wooden tables, flickering oil lanterns set on their surfaces, and cushioned chairs offer areas to spread out and read or study.  Scents of parchment, glue, and dust permeate the room.  The well-manicured librarian stands behind a low wooden checkout desk, its surface littered with folios, quills, and jars of ink.

title: [Museum, Hall of Knowledge]
description: Mahogany-paneled walls encapsulate this small room.  Low bookshelves dot the pale gold marble floor, their dark mahogany surfaces polished to a shine and adorned with astrolabes, compasses, and various other objects.  A solid oak door with a small gold plaque resides between two tapestries depicting scholars at work studying tomes and scrolls.  On the opposite wall, an onyx arch leads to another room.  Standing between the two exits is a white metal sign on an iron stand, while on the south side wall, a mahogany arch with a bas-relief floral design leads to the second floor lobby.

title: [Wehnimer's Museum, Basement]
description: Lined on both sides by flickering torches, this room is part of a tunnel beneath the museum.  A set of stone steps leads upward toward a brighter light, while the enclosed passage stretches on to the east and west, its rough walls crafted from timber braces and mortared stone.

title: [Wehnimer's Museum, Grand Foyer]
[Wehnimer's Museum, Grand Lobby]
description: White marble columns, set halfway into the walls, serve as both decoration and structural support for the high ceiling.  Set between them are some colorful velvet settees that offer respite for weary patrons.  The cool marble floor is interrupted by a pale gold carpet that leads up an expansive staircase.  In the center of the western wall is a green marble arch, while the eastern wall sports a white marble arch.  Across the room from a gold marble arch, a large platinum plaque and a rectangular white sign are displayed beside the oaken double doors that lead outside.

You are in the grand entry hall of the Wehnimer's Museum.  This building houses much ancient and historical lore, artifacts and antiquities.  The museum complex consists of galleries bedecked in fine works of art, wings devoted to historical artifacts, a library of rare manuscripts, a wing devoted to the natural history of Elanthia, and a Hall of Magic and Technology.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west, out

title: [Wehnimer's Museum, Planetarium]
description: The black walls are circular, creating a dark cylindrical space.  Domed, the ceiling is riddled with tiny holes and lit from behind.  The light shining through the holes mimics the starlight on a cloudless night.  All the constellations well-known to the local area can be seen among the stars.  A narrow stone staircase leading up and a set of spiral stone stairs leading down rest against one curved wall, while four constellation tapestries hang an equidistance from each other on the rounded walls, their contents illuminated by the starlight from above.

title: [Hall of Knowledge, Laboratory]
description: The room is dim, a faint luminescence emanating from a single shelf mounted on the wall that houses several glowing potions under a glass case.  There are small plaques on the shelf in front of each potion, their metal surfaces gleaming in the half-light of the room.  Centrally located, a simmering cast iron cauldron over a magical blue flame sits adjacent to a mortar and pestle that rest on a small pedestal.  A gnarled ebonwood arch leads to the northwest, while an onyx arch leads southwest.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Highland]
description: The ground is littered with a thick layer of crisp brown leaves that crunch underfoot.  Downslope to the west, pools of murky water lie stagnant on the ground.  A perpetual, misty fog hangs in the air, blocking even an occasional glimspe of the starry black skies.

The ground is littered with a thick layer of crisp brown leaves that crunch underfoot.  Downslope to the west, pools of murky water lie stagnant on the ground.  A perpetual, misty fog hangs in the air, resisting the attempt of the sun's rays to burn it off.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Black Waters]
description: None of the ground here is dry, and wooden slats have been strewn across it in a token attempt to keep people from sinking knee deep in the muck.  To the east is a muddy path leading inland and to the west is a raised plank walkway.

title: [Wrought From Rot, Ledge]
description: Humidity soaks you in a bath of sticky air at the top of the hollowed out cypress.  Mold grows in dense clusters on the ceiling and wars silently with a moss-covered wall for territory in the corners.  The scent of mildew is protrusive.

Humidity saturates the air at the top of the hollowed out cypress and mold grows in dense clusters on the ceiling, warring silently with a moss-covered wall for territory in the corners.  The scent of mildew is protrusive.

title: [Wrought From Rot]
description: Heat and humidity saturate the air, and a single torch is mounted on a long length of rattan to better illuminate the interior of the tree.  Crooked wooden stands are nonchalantly placed against walls covered in moss and spiderwebs.  The floor is a soft, squishy combination of trampled swamp grasses and mud.

title: [Black Banyan, Trunk]
description: The airy, open chamber is multi-leveled, arising organically out of a wind-carved pocket within the monumental trunk of the tree.  A similar pocket leads out from the room, and several of the heavy boughs are wide enough to act as paths in their own rights.  A single burning lantern hangs from the ceiling, illuminating a staircase leading further up into the canopy and a spiraling ramp leading downwards towards the base of the tree.

title: [Black Banyan, Westerly Limb]
description: A mass of woven ropes, akin to a loose net, forms a protective tunnel around the heavy bough.  Openings in the mesh provide porthole views beyond the edge of the tree and down the western slope of the hill it sits upon.  A bit of graffito scratched is scratched into the banyan's bark, within easy reading distance of a natural arch leading into the interior of the tree itself.

title: [Dollhouse, Entry]
description: The varnished mahogany walls enclosing the area are accentuated by the elegant ebonwood chairs set about the wagon.  A single chandelier casts illumination upon the center, highlighting the soft lamb's wool area rug occupying the floor.  A claw-footed table of mahogany rests on the rug, a tall-backed upholstered chair on either side.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Banyan Cirque]
description: Long tendrils of grey-green moss drape gracefully from the overhead branches of an ancient cedar.  An artistic touch has been rendered with the twisting of red silk ribbons into the tendrils, like a grey-haired matriarch with beribboned braids.  Beneath the living curtain, chiseled-stone statues stand sentinel at the corners of a raised wooden platform.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Highland]
description: Neither trees nor brush add greenery to this large mud-flat at the apex of multiple pathways.  Deep rivulets and gouges mark the path of rainfall where it journeys from the higher ground inland, down towards the open water.  Fastidiously moored in the intransigent mud, a dilapidated boat with a twisted rope drooping down from its interior provides both respite, and an invitation for yet more revelry.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Limestone Strand]
description: At the bottom of the slightly sloped land, a narrow path leading inland converges on to the stretch of mud-embraced shore.  Black ash trees, their trunks as thin and spindly as spider legs, congregate in the shallow water with several pond cypress, where swamp ferns claw their long fingers at anything within reach.

title: [A Pocket Full]
description: The scent of leather pervades this room, mixed with lantern oil, and a faint flowery scent.  A darkly stained oak crate crammed with goods rests on the floor near the front, while a small cherry oak dresser with open drawers stands against the wall to one side, below an etched metal sign.  The area is lit with several flickering lanterns set along the rustic log walls, between two of which, a row of hooks displays more wares to be sold.  At the back of the wagon, a small archway affords further entrance, while opposite, an open doorway housing a set of steps leads back outside.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Highland]
description: A proliferation of fiddlehead ferns flourishes here, each nestled snuggly against its neighbor.  Near the pathway most are small, their curling tops barely reaching ankle height of those making their way through the growth.  To each side, ferns of greater maturity are fully unfurled, reaching heights that would tower above the average gnome.

A proliferation of fiddlehead ferns flourishes here, each nestled snugly against its neighbor.  Near the pathway most are small, their curling tops barely reaching ankle height of those making their way through the growth.  To each side, ferns of greater maturity are fully unfurled, reaching heights that would tower above the average gnome.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Trail of Hexes]
description: The main path widens here as bootprints converge from several points of origin, most showing the direction of travel to be northward towards a large banyan.  A smaller number lead downslope toward the deeper swamp.  The tracks alone would not be disturbing, were it not for the very large, reptilian, claw-tipped tracks overlaying some of the bootprints leading toward the swamp.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Duckweed Haven]
description: A partially beached shanty boat is anchored to the shoreline with sturdy hemp lines.  Its painted facade is a patchwork of faded mint green and exposed metal.  The floating plantlife surrounding it appears to have not been disturbed for quite some time, with tiny shoots and runners wending their way into crevices near the vessel's waterline.  The available light reveals at least a dozen pairs of eyes within the floating duckweed.  Heading south, a rickety bridge heads toward an ebon gate.

A partially beached shanty boat is anchored to the shoreline with sturdy hemp lines.  Its painted facade is a patchwork of faded mint green and exposed metal.  The floating plantlife surrounding it appears to have not been disturbed for quite some time, with tiny shoots and runners wending their way into crevices near the vessel's waterline.  The tops of armor-like, reptilian backs can be seen protruding motionlessly from within the floating duckweed.  Heading south, a rickety bridge heads toward an ebon gate.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Highland]
description: A looming cypress holds dominion over the converging pathways, with knobby knees encircling the buttressed base.  Like a matriach from ages past, the graceful giant is draped in a centuries-old gown of grey-green moss.

A looming cypress holds dominion over the converging pathways, with knobby knees encircling the buttressed base.  Like a matriarch from ages past, the graceful giant is draped in a centuries-old gown of grey-green moss.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Bald Cypress Arc]
description: A dense copse of trees hugs the water's edge, while a small hole has worn through the limestone shore's crumbly base to form an inland pool ringed with swamp rose bushes.  The limestone then rises up at a low slant, the formation immediately covered with a thick coating of brownish-black mud, with a barely-there path cutting through it and leading inland.  Bridging over the swamp's expanse of water, a raised wood plank walkway makes its way through into the darkness.

The limestone then rises up at a low slant, the formation immediately covered with a thick coating of brownish-black mud, with a barely-there path cutting through it and leading inland.  Bridging over the swamp's expanse of water, a raised wood plank walkway makes its way through curtains of moss.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Misty Shore]
description: Steady waves lap against the shore, the noise loud and startling in the quiet swamp.  Black gum trees grow up just off-shore, with several fallen trunks surrounding the tempestuous, leaf-strewn water.  Further out, the dark water is completely still.

title: [Instrumental Interlude, Cave]
description: Several musty crates have been pushed to one corner and covered with a mold-ridden cloth.  Pockmarks and holes dot the walls, their interiors alive with the gurgle of hidden water flow.  The stone floor is blanketed by a thick layer of dust, interrupted only by the passage of unseen vermin.  Resting near the cave mouth is a wooden chest, its lid hanging by a single hinge.  A stone opening leads deeper into the cave, flanked on both sides by torches stuck into the floor.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Black Waters]
description: The trees thin out here, leaving a large expanse of water between the shore and the next spot of solid land.  In between, lumps of dead, leafy refuse spot the water, shifting occasionally in the visible current.  At the edge of the shore, a large black stone rests beneath a black gum tree, the duo surrounded in a wide radius by nothing but the corpses of insects and small animals in various stages of decay.

title: [The Hair Apparent, Nook]
description: Cramped and close, as though added onto the building as an afterthought, this nook has very little room to move in.  Sitting in the direct center of the space is a hard wooden stool, the floor around it littered in various old hair clippings.  A tray of tools has been shoved into one corner, its surface covered in combs, razors, scissors, and other unidentifiable sharp instruments.  There is a barely noticeable whiff of burnt hair permeating the stuffy air.

title: [Belly of the Burghal]
description: The cabin sits at a crazy, tilted angle, turning walls into floor and ceiling and ceiling and floor into walls.  Upended shipping containers protrude from the sludge of mud and wet filth that has seeped into the chamber, the continued suck and draw of which threatens to eventually consume the vessel entirely.  A single hatch in the metal cladding of the crashed airship is the only viable entrance or egress, though even that is partially askew.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Bald Cypress Arc]
description: Crawling over the shoreline, creepers seem to be slowly choking the life out a collection of white orchids, several of which already dangle, dead, within the grasp of the vines.  Barely moving, the water, black as night, stands still amid the bald cypress growth.  Small cooing sounds flit through the air from an unknown source.

title: [Close Yer Robe, Porch]
description: The wood plank flooring has rotten through in several places, leaving large holes in the surface and making walking here treacherous.  A dilapidated porch swing hangs from the listing tin roof that is so laden with rusty holes that it does not protect from the elements at all.  The paint on the railing has peeled almost completely, leaving the bare wood showing from beneath.  A layer of mold and grime coats every surface, including a trio of steps that leads down, and the frame of the open doorway that offers entrance.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Highland]
description: The decayed skeleton of a large cat rests half in and half out of a small brackish pool beside the main path.  Its jaw is frozen in a silent scream, and bits of leathered skin cling tenuously to its bones.  An odd growth of fungi clutters the surrounding area.

title: [Rods Springs N' Blades]
description: Brightly colored safety ropes surround a central trapdoor, attempting to prevent the less wary from falling through it.  Polished modwir planks form the walls, floor and ceiling of the boarding cabin.  Coils of ropes and a pile of harnesses fill a corner of the sparse room, and a sturdy steel door leads into another area of the craft.  An iron-edged modwir sign rests against a nearby wall.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Limestone Strand]
description: At the bottom of the slightly sloped land, a narrow path leading inland converges on to the stretch of mud-embraced shore.  Black ash trees, their trunks as thin and spindly as spider legs, congregate in the shallow water with several pond cypress, where swamp ferns claw their long fingers at anything within reach.

title: [Instrumental Interlude, Passage]
description: The narrow stone passage is lined with several openings.  A half-collapsed passage, and a twisting side tunnel lead off to either side, while a stone opening and a rusted metal drainpipe stand at each end.  Oddly, the space is dimly lit by stumpy candles resting in sconces that line the stone walls on both sides of the passage.  A single high shelf adorns the stone wall between two such sconces.

Oddly, the space is dimly lit by stumpy candles resting in sconces that line the stone walls on both sides of the passage.  A single high shelf adorns the stone wall, situated above a low table and between two such sconces.

title: [Instrumental Interlude, Tunnel]
description: The passage is almost completely dark, only illuminated by the light from the candles that filters in through the mouth of the tunnel.  A faint trickle of water can be heard from somewhere in the back of the room, the sound reverberating in the small space.  Just within the dim pool of light, a slatted wooden crate rests on its side, its contents threatening to spill out onto the stone floor.

title: [Krolvin Warship, Captain's Room]
description: Several hurricane lanterns hang from the paneled wooden ceiling, the flames within casting light and shadows across the cabin.  Rich pine borders the edges of the walls, adding a decorative touch and feel to the cabin that is lacking elsewhere in the ship.  A large pine table bolted to the deck sits at the center with a heavy chair behind it, while a large bunk fills the deck space beneath the grimy stern windows.
from.location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Great Western Sea]
description: The icy, dark blue water of the Northern Waves stretches out around you in every direction.  Rippling waves, some topped with whitecaps, chop up the surface and make it difficult for you to tread water.  The triple masts of the krolvin warship tower over the much smaller schooner.  You notice that a ladder extends down from the schooner's deck to the east.
to.location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Erythro Island, Forest Ring]
description: A chorus of mournful wails eerily fill the forest, their cries sounding forlorn and distant.  Birds take to the sky, dark silhouettes against the ruddy sky.

title: [Erythro Island, Blood Tunnel]
description: The walls of the tunnel are unnaturally smooth and their surfaces covered in dark blood.  Small radiant red orbs hover throughout the underground passageway, their scarlet light bathing the area in a crimson glow.

title: [Stone Keep, Courtyard]
description: Stone rubble from the wall above lays in scattered chunks around the courtyard, the rocks layered with a solid coat of ice.  A frayed rope leads back up to the keep's perimeter.

title: [Stone Keep, Outer Wall]
description: The stone wall has completely collapsed here making any further travel around the keep impossible.  A fraying rope hangs down the side of the wall and lowers into the open courtyard below.

title: [Stone Keep, Hall]
description: In a lattice design along the walls, large veins spread out and glow with a unnatural crimson light.  The glowing veins lead to the center of the hall, which has been completely engulfed by a massive blood red tunnel leading down.

title: [Erythro Island, Blood Cavern]
description: The walls of the tunnel are covered in slimy blood and veins, looking more like the inside of an intestine than a passageway.  A pale red light faintly shines out from the web of veins.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: Crude symbols have been scratched into the rocks along a tunnel wall here.  Nearby, a crude wooden ladder leads up to a hinged trapdoor.

title: [Scribe, Front Room]
description: The walls of Jenkin the Scrivener's office are honeycombed with scroll and book shelves, all empty.  A thin layer of dust covers the room.  An elegantly penned note hangs from the upper edge of a writing desk in the middle of the room.  Through the archway north, a very large screw-like contraption can be seen.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: The fractured remnants of an animal's skull lie amidst a pile of dusty bones in a corner of the tunnel, where it opens into a wide turn.  Nearby, a crude wooden ladder leads up to a hinged trapdoor.

title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Forest]
description: The evidence of a lightning strike is more pronounced here, and even massive trees have been felled and charred.  One impressive ruin is the huge trunk of a fallen modwir, which lies upon the ground.  Just barely the height of a man, a hole in the trunk shows it to be hollow.

title: [Begetting Besiegers, Basement]
description: Narrow wooden steps lead down from the trapdoor in the ceiling, ending in a wide underground chamber.  Old rusty sconces cast a dim glow along the earthen walls, creating thick pockets of shadows that partially conceal a flimsy wooden door.

title: [Begetting Besiegers, Backroom]
description: Windowless and dim, it's a wonder how the artisan gets any detailed work done.  A small leather-padded stool rests between two paint-stained tables, easily affording the craftsman an ample amount of space.  Short shelves and stands hold an assortment of half-finished miniatures, many still colorless or missing limbs.  Tart crumbs are scattered about the floor.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: While most of the tunnel is shrouded in darkness, this section is aglow from the orange light of several torches set into the earthen walls.  The passageway is warm from the burning torches, and half a dozen troll skeletons litter the ground.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: Fragrant evergreens cover the side of the ridge here.  Years of battling the elements have stunted and twisted their growth as they cling to the rocks and rubble that clutter the side of the hill.

title: [Zephyr Hall, Landing]
description: Dark red satinwood paneling covers the bottom half of the walls, while the top half is painted a pale cream hue.  Sconces of polished brass hang on the wall, and a hammered tin ceiling displays an elaborate scene of hunters cornering their quarry.  A long runner of animal hides pieced into a repeated compass rose pattern ends at each of the three doors opening off of the area, while the staircase is left bare for its craftsmanship to shine.

title: [Zephyr Hall, Gecko Room]
description: This spacious room is dominated by several oak-framed divans covered in quilted sepia suede.  Two overstuffed chairs flank a heavy, brass-studded side table under a panoramic curtained window.  The pale yellow walls are painted in a pattern of ochre-colored geckos climbing towards the ceiling, interrupted to the south by a wide oak door.  One delicate gold chandelier hangs from the intersection of two beams of oak underneath exposed rafters.

title: [Burga Hall, Courtyard]
description: A cobbled path, leading from the black gate to the porch steps, breaks the monotony of the white-encrusted landscape.  The path's stones are a multi-hued mosaic that repeats a colorful abstract pattern along its length.  The walkway is free from ice and snow, proof of a groundskeeper who keeps it clear.  Iceblossoms and frostflowers add their pale colors to the flower beds that hug the wall of the low, wide building.  Branching from the main path, a long snow-packed trail leads into the trees at the side of the hall.

title: [Burga Hall, Porch]
description: Long and rectangular, this room encompasses about half of the front facade of the building.  The hardwood floor is kept free from debris and snow by an absorbent rug resting by the door leading out.  With stone bricks comprising the bottom half of the walls and wood planks making up the top, the room has a rustic feel, amplified by the wrought iron lanterns that illuminate the area from their perch in niches along the walls.  Near the entry, a white wooden table holds a variety of glittering objects.

title: [Burga Hall, Foyer]
description: Dark oak-paneled walls encapsulate the room on all sides, broken by several ports of entry.  A set of soft burgundy arm chairs face each other across a muted gold area rug that covers the center of the ebonwood flooring.  Against the nearby wall, an oak sideboard provides various refreshments for those waiting in the foyer.  In the eastern wall, an archway leads to a dimly lit room, while in the western wall, a carved oak door and a curved frost white doorway are separated by potted ferns.  Tendrils of cold emanate from the cracks around a set of glass double doors.

title: [Burga Hall, Tavern]
description: The area is lit by panoramic windows that take up the top half of the exterior walls, while the bottom is paneled in a cherry oak that lends warmth to the room.  The paneling is broken only by a carved cherry oak door and a rounded black oak archway, as well as several ensconced lanterns.  At one side of the room, an expansive wooden bar holds a variety of concoctions, and behind it a colorful banner hangs on the wall.  Scattered around a plush forest green carpet are tables and chairs stained a slightly lighter shade than the paneling.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Passage]
description: A single, unwavering torch illuminates a long, roughly hewn stone hallway.  Flecks of ore and crystal glimmer out from the natural rock walls, and coarse rockdust litters the floor, causing footfalls to crunch softly.  Dark passages lead off to the south and the west, and some rough stairs lead up into yet more gloom.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Foyer]
description: Black obsidian walls, polished to a sheen that nearly matches that of the tall silver mirror that stands at the west end of the foyer, rise to the vaulted ceiling thirty feet above.  A gracefully curved staircase of black marble winds along the walls, leading upwards into the higher reaches of the tower.  Dark banners emblazoned with symbols of the Dhe'nari castes hang high on the walls, and a set of double doors carved of black ora opens to the south.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Banyan]
description: The winding, lattice-work pattern of the bark makes for easy climbing, providing several nooks comfortable for sitting.  Twisted tree-roots hang down from the branches above, creating a skeletal canopy.  A light mist swirls down from the thick, leafy roof.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Banyan]
description: Deep lacerations in the tree and tufts of dark fur caught in the uneven bark mark the area as a resting place of some large cat.  Several liana hang down from the branches above, swaying slightly back and forth.  A fresh scent fills the air, a distinct change after the decay below.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Stepped Valley]
description: Though as verdant and overwhelmed by the growth of grasses and ferns as the rest of the valley, a raised plateau to the north does provide some means of visually pinpointing location.  A few large boulders litter the ground, perhaps washed down from the sloping sides of the tableland during harsh weather.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Highlands]
description: Raised above the level of the rest of the valley, the plateau is a haven for huge ferns and even a few of the larger jungle trees.  From this vantage point, a section of coastal cliff is plainly visible in the distance.  One fallen tree trunk forms a bridge of sorts to a small ridge in those cliffs.  To the south the sloping sides of the tableland provide a natural descent to the floor of the cirque below.

To the south, the sloping sides of the tableland provide a natural descent to the floor of the cirque below.

title: [Alhan'aht River, Hilly Pass]
description: Slipping in and out of the gently curving landscape, the river picks up a bit of speed as it leaves the dark hills of the south and heads towards the northern jungle.  The western bank is comprised of a sheer cliff of dark granite, while the eastern bank has been fitted with a small landing dock.  Arching over the water course is an aerial bridge crafted of rough granite and pebbles.

title: [Alhan'aht River, Landing]
description: Several rafts are tied to anchor on either side of the smooth oak dock that occupies most of the rocky landing.  Broad-leafed tropical plants display signs of recent cutting along the edges of the clearing, while a pathway of granite, pebbles, vines, and dirt arcs across the river towards the distant shore.

title: [Monastery, Masters' Bridge]
description: Leaves drift effortlessly about on a disturbingly cool breeze that travels across and under the bridge.  Long hemp cords bind the swaying bridge to tree branches high up in the canopy, and slender glass globes are tied to the rope hand railings.  The sound of rushing water filters across the path from a cliff that can be seen in the distance, while white cobblestones gleam in the sunlight from the courtyard that the bridge empties into at its other end.

title: [Monastery Ruins, Cliff]
description: The plateau leads to a steep cliff that overlooks the dense jungle.  A swaying rope bridge connects the cliff to the monastery below as it stretches over the forest's canopy.  A parting in the leaves beneath the bridge reveals several motes of torchlight glistening from the forest floor.  Centered in the plateau stands a run-down citadel, the majority of its towers and walls cracked and broken.  An arched doorway, long bereft of an actual door, leads deeper into the stronghold.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Stone Tree]
description: Scratched into the bedrock is this hollow cavern that stretches below a great banyan.  A solitary candle on a simple altar lends illumination and shadows to the pockmarked and irregular formations surrounding the underground den.  An elaborate upside-down tree growing down from the ceiling has been shaped from the banyan's roots and mirrored in carvings that span the stone walls.  A light musk infiltrates as the air is stirred through the cavern, and a subtle but oppressive silence hangs in the air.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Corpse Copse]
description: What distinguishes this portion of the jungle is the abundant growth of rafflesia, many of the fungi in bloom with their enormous flame-hued flowers.  Lying low to the ground, the parasitic plants attach to the root systems of the multitude of liana vines growing up the trunks and limbs of a tight stand of rubber trees.  The stench given off by the rafflesia blooms is pervasive, similar to that of rotting flesh and attracting flies by the hundreds.

The stench given off by the rafflesia blooms is pervasive, similar to that of rotting flesh and attracting flies by the hundreds.

title: [Earthen Cave, Undertree]
description: A rough stone ladder descends from above near the very edge of the room.  The cave's chamber is walled with hard-packed soil, held in by a network of roots that crisscross the walls like the threads of a spider's web, two of which flank a narrow earthen passage.  A large bundle of roots descends from the center of the ceiling in a writhing tangle, some tips curled around glowing crimson globes, creating a macabre chandelier.  Set beneath the roots is a fire pit, while in the background, set into the wall, is a niche containing an ornamented skeleton.

title: [Shadowed Clearing]
description: Dense canopy surrounds this small clearing encasing it in cool dark shadow.  Thin white mist enshrouds a stained stone slab that is surrounded by tiny black gravel in the center of the clearing.  No living thing disturbs the silent grip that stillness holds on this secret, hidden glen.  Over the slab, three small orbs slowly hover, spinning around each other and casting a faint silvery light that mutes nearby colors into varied shades of pale whites, cool grays, and pitch blacks.  Between two trees is an arch of tangled boughs.

title: [Rogue Guild, Access Points]
description: Narrowing quickly, the huge tunnel deadends in a thick metal grate that completely covers one end.  Bits of paper and various other waste cling to the cross bars of the grate indicating that, at times, there is considerably more water here than now.  A rusty iron ladder leads up to a manhole above.

title: [Eastern Harbor, Crane Lane]
description: White picket fences, their thick and thin slats entangled with vines laden with niveous violet-striped clematis and red-throated saffron hibiscus, encircle the yards of the houses that line the cobbled street.  Shell-lined pathways wind their way through the verdant lawns that the fences encircle and allow easy passage from the street to the cottages beyond, some of which have signs proclaiming them to be shops.  Lamps, their glass windows glinting in the sunlight, dangle from wrought iron shepherd's crooks that line the streets.

title: [The Colonnade, Hallway]
description: The hallway here is brightly lit, with oil lamps resting in elaborate pewter sconces along the walls on both sides.  A wooden stage door stands between two sconces leading stage left, while a dressing room door in the opposite wall is clearly marked with a gilded golden star.  At each end of the hallway, a polished oak door leads into the audience chamber.

title: [The Colonnade, Auditorium]
description: Opposite the set of double doors leading in, the stage stretches from one end of the room to the other, beyond the proscenium arch with its dividing burgundy curtain.  Facing the stage, row upon row of opulent rowan benches, covered in soft burgundy velvet cushions, stand upon the black marble floor.  Torches around the room serve to light the space, and can be snuffed or lit as needed.  The proscenium steps on either side of the stage are each flanked by a small oak door leading out of the room.

title: [The Colonnade, Hallway]
description: The hallway here is brightly lit, with oil lamps resting in elaborate pewter sconces along the walls on both sides.  A wooden stage door stands between two sconces leading stage left, while a dressing room door in the opposite wall is clearly marked with a gilded golden star.  At each end of the hallway, a polished oak door leads into the audience chamber.

title: [The Colonnade, Backstage]
description: This small space is cramped, with props and scenery piled in haphazard stacks on either side of a narrow walkway.  The rope for the curtain stretches from ceiling to floor near the light switches, the pulleys glisten with oil to avoid squeaking, and the wooden lever is buffed smooth.  Providing access to the stage are two arches, while at the back of the room, a wooden stage door leads out to the hallway.

title: [The Colonnade, Balcony]
description: Where the staircase ends, its beautiful carved railings spread to each side, dividing the balcony from the open space above the lobby with twisting marble wildflowers and twining ivy vines.  Velvet ropes define the areas open to the public and those which require tickets.  A rowan door embossed with a silver plaque rests in the wall at one end, while an oak door embossed with a gold plaque stands at the other.

title: [The Colonnade, Box Seat Gold]
description: High above the auditorium, this box seat provides a perfect view of the stage and its heavy curtain.  Gold accents on the railings and thickly padded marble chairs sparkle in the lamp light as the flames flicker within their glass containers.  Serving trays rest on wheeled carts on the thick burgundy carpet near an oak door embossed with golden scrollwork leading back outside.

title: [Rogue Guild, Sewers]
description: Rounded cobblestones are stacked with precision to create the smooth walls, which gently curve upward to create a domed ceiling.  Piles of debris are clustered along the southern wall, the faint scent of decay and mildew rising from them, though the northern wall appears to be largely clear where a sewer-capped ladder disappears into the ceiling.  Oddly deep, several claw marks mar the lower area of the rounded walls.

title: [Eastern Harbor, Sea Turtle Lane]
description: Surrounded by flowering trees, the teak and cedar villa sprawls across a petal-strewn lawn along the northern edge of the street.  Glassless windows provide a view of the cobalt blue walls of the interior, while the exterior is marked by an elegant painted sign and an arched entry that exudes a welcoming atmosphere.  Golden sunlight illuminates the tangled clusters of the surrounding foliage, which provides a pleasant contrast to the bright white of the cobblestoned street.

Surrounded by flowering trees, the teak and cedar villa sprawls across a petal-strewn lawn along the northern edge of the street.  Wide open windows, illuminated from within, provide a view of the cobalt blue walls of the interior, while the exterior is marked by an elegant painted sign and an arched entry that exudes a welcoming atmosphere.  Circles of lamplight pool upon the cobblestones and cast shadows in the surrounding foliage that partially obscure a vast marble castle.

title: [Rogue Guild, Sewers]
description: Much of the water flowing into the area cascades through the gates in the floor in a frothy rush, leaving the available footing covered with spray and as slippery as metal.   Recessed into the wall, a ladder pushes up toward a trapdoor.

title: [A Dark Warehouse]
description: Cramped and crowded, the small room appears to be a warehouse with brick walls and a knotty oak floor.  Stacks of boxes and containers are piled to the ceiling in many places and create a labyrinthine maze of packed goods.  Incredibly faint light leaks out from behind one particular short stack of wooden crates, while light from the alley also filters in through the open doorway.

title: [Sewers, Beneath the Slaughter]
description: Smelling heavily of carnage, the dank passage is illuminated by a single torch resting in a bracket beside a blackened wrought iron ladder that leads upwards towards the oak ceiling.  Sanguine stains darken the walls and packed dirt floor.

title: [The Slaughterhouse]
description: Cracked and peeling paint decorate the walls of the small shop, their curled ends littering the rough floor amid a layer of scattered sawdust.  One long counter stretches across the room, easily dividing the shopping space from the work area.  Implements of the butchering trade, such as razor strops, black iron rib cutters, and knives, dangle from black iron hooks, which stand over sanguine filled buckets.

title: [Rogue Guild, Sewers]
description: Scents of garlic and herbs mingle with those of rotten food.  The water flows slowly past piles of food wastes in various states of decay.  A soft click-click in the darkness suggests that the piles are feasts for some.  Rising from a pile of fresh slop, a slippery ladder leads upward to the apparent source.

title: [Monkey Fist, Storage Closet]
description: Roughly the size of a broom closet, the small room is illuminated by what light spills in from beyond a doorway to the Monkey Fist kitchen.  A well-used refuse chute sits beneath various storage shelves at the back of the room, and is surrounded by carrot, fruit, and cucumber peels.

Roughly the size of a broom closet, the small room is illuminated by what light spills in from beyond the a doorway to the Monkey Fist kitchen.  A well-used refuse chute sits beneath various storage shelves at the back of the room, and is surrounded by carrot, fruit, and cucumber peels.

title: [Rogue Guild, Training Nexus]
description: Several iron-grated drains are recessed into the uneven cobblestone of the floor and surround a raised platform that is covered in steel sheets.  Large alcoves lined in white and black stones are arranged around the north, west, and southern walls, their depths illuminated by candles from within.  Surrounding the eastern passage into the sewers is an old iron ladder, that leads up, and a rough oak table that is heavily scarred with jagged gashes.

title: [Warehouse, Tanner's Haven]
description: Thick and cloying, the air in this section of the warehouse is heavy with the acrid scent of chemicals despite the wide open window located in its eastern wall.  Curing frames hang from the exposed rafters above vats filled with viscous liquids, while a long counter stretching across the opposite wall provides ample workspace for the various apprentices that move through the room completing obscure tasks.

title: [Sewers, The Underside of Locks]
description: Flickering light from the north spills into this section of the tunnel, though its licking fingers do not invade the deep shadows to the south.  Rising along the eastern wall, and bolted into place by large iron brackets, is a blackened ladder that leads from the cobblestone floor and disappears into the wooden ceiling.

title: [Locks and More, Workshop]
description: The ceiling slants downward from a peak overhead, mimicking the shape of the roof above.  Hooks have been placed on the lower part of the ceiling towards one side of the room, various tools used in the art of locksmithing and repairing lockpicks hanging from them.  Beneath them is a worn oak table that looks as though it might once have been a fine piece.  Windows up near the peak of the ceiling on either side of the room provide the only light, the lamps overhead unlit.

Moonlight filters through the windows up near the peak of the ceiling, the lamps overhead lit to provide more light.

title: [Sewers, The Underside of Gems]
description: Bright light spills into this short passage from the south, its brilliance illuminating every stone, corner, and crevice in the area.  A single ladder rises from the stone floor and disappears into the wooden rafters of the ceiling.

title: [Etaenia's Jewels]
description: Blue, green, and purple striped rugs are scattered about on the floor, like small islands, while an oak counter partially spans one side of the room.  A jeweler's loupe rests upon the counter at one end, and jewels in the process of being cut, cleaned, and polished sit at the other, in front of a padded stool.  Curtains matching the rugs hang upon the windows that adorn the walls, the curtains drawn back allowing daylight to enter.

Curtains matching the rugs hang upon the windows that adorn the walls, and crystal lamps are hung between the windows, providing additional lighting.

title: [Sewers, The Underside of Health]
description: Glass globes housed in copper cages are suspended from the ceiling and provide ample illumination for this section of the tunnel.  Painted bright white, the walls, ceiling, and floor are all uniformly the same and a narrow cot appears to be the only furnishing.  A blackened iron ladder leads upward through a small trapdoor.

title: [Healer's House]
description: Filmy blue chiffon curtains blow gently in the breeze from the open windows, while a small calico cat snoozes beneath them in a patch of light on the floor.  Drying herbs hang from hooks upon the wall, waiting to be used in various medicines.  A small table covered with bandages and medicines sits next to a padded table covered with a sheet.  Next to an embroidered curtain rests a large basket filled with dried lilacs, giving the room a pleasant scent.

Filmy blue chiffon curtains blow gently in the breeze from the open windows, while a small calico cat bats lazily at them from a big blue cushion on the floor.  A large quantity of lamps hanging overhead keep the room well lit.  A small table covered with bandages and medicines sits next to a padded table covered with a sheet.  Next to an embroidered curtain rests a large basket filled with dried lilacs, giving the room a pleasant scent.

title: [Sewers, Under Lock and Key]
description: Roughly carved out of dirt, the terminus is surrounded on four sides by walls and has a small tunnel that leads towards a central nexus.  Spidery white roots decorate the smooth walls and the floor is pitted with oddly shaped rocks.  Four thick support posts mark the corners of the area, while a blackened iron ladder rises towards the knotty oak ceiling where a small trap door stands closed.  A waxed parchment is tacked near the ladder.

title: [Mist Harbor Lockup, Cell]
description: Bitter and bleak, the air hardly moves in here except for a single vent in the center of the ceiling.  A thin shaft of moonlight is the only access to the outside through a vertical crack in the outside wall.  A small metal table is bolted to the floor as is a sturdy metal cot next to it.

A large fallen log rests underneath the shade of several of its companion trees, its roughened jagged-edged body covered in an array of vines and insects.  Butterflies flutter in and out of small patches of wildflowers flourishing near the edge of the jungle, their jewel-toned wings creating a subtle, yet distinctive, buzz in the humid air.  The presence of an occasional breeze, wafting in from the nearby river, alleviates the discomfort of the sauna-like surroundings.

title: [Sewers, Portal to Freedom]
description: Terminating to the northwest in a round grate, the sewer is fashioned of cobblestones and wrought iron.  Bright sunlight illuminates the passage and the scent of sea salt fills the air.

title: [Western Harbor, Pier One]
description: New planks mingle with older ones upon the pier, their addition creating a stripped pattern across the smooth platform as it juts a short distance out into the sea.  A series of oak steps leads to the main dock on one side of the pier, while on the opposite side is a small canvas-sided awning sheltering a bench.  Fishing boats are moored to the edge of the dock, their arrangement neat and tidy with an equidistant spacing between each.

title: [Sewers, Under the Scuttle]
description: Transitioning from cobblestones to knotty oak, the ceiling of the passage is largely hidden in shadows.  Smooth stone walls give way to a wall of packed dirt in the southeast, where a blackened wrought iron ladder disappears through a trapdoor above.  The scent of freshly baked bread mingles oddly with the overall dankness of the area.

title: [Scuttlebug Tavern]
description: Rough oak planks spread from the entry at one end of the room to the dinghy-shaped bar that is surrounded by stools at the other, their slender surfaces riddled with large and small knots.  High above, a chandelier housing dozens of candles provides ample illumination for each of the various tables that are scattered throughout, while also illuminating the various signs that hang from the rafters.  A rickety staircase leads to the upstairs and connects with a balcony that encircles half of the tavern.

title: [Silvergate, 3rd Floor Hallway]
description: Thick carpeting muffles your footsteps and warms this room.  A small window in the western wall overlooks a courtyard far below and the forest beyond.  Simply furnished, there is a single table and a straight-backed chair resting at the window.  A wide carpeted staircase leads back to the lounge far below.

title: [Silvergate, Dianatrue's Suite]
description: A warm-hued, hardwood oak floor is polished to a lustrous glow, and matching thick ceiling supports frame a leaded crystal dome.  One wall, created entirely of intricately mortared pieces of flagstone, holds a massive fireplace with an oak mantelpiece.  Deep-cushioned wing chairs of wicker ring a small, cloth-covered table in one corner, and a four poster bed rests directly beneath the crystal dome.  A curtained archway leads to a balcony, and an alcove holds an indistinct shape in its recesses.

title: [House Sylvanfair, Treetop]
description: Branches intertwine to form several large benches here, covered with moss and soft pillows.  There's just enough of a breeze to be refreshing, and the songs of the birds and the chattering of the animals that live in the tree provide soft background noise.  One branch, larger than the rest, arches off to the east.  A spiral staircase leads back down into the trunk of the tree, curving around a cunningly carved tangle of branches.

Branches intertwine to form several large benches here, covered with moss and soft pillows.  There's just enough of a breeze to be refreshing, and the muted noises of the insects that live in the tree provide soft background noise.  One branch, larger than the rest, arches off to the east.  A spiral staircase leads back down into the trunk of the tree, curving around a cunningly carved tangle of branches.

title: [Lady Lissa's Chamber]
description: The warmth of this chamber welcomes you, as the room is engulfed by the sun reaching through the intricately carved openings in the bark walls.  In one corner, a four-posted bed draped with a cockatrice feather comforter invites you to bask in the tranquility of your surroundings.  Below a painting on the opposite wall is an oak desk, covered with scrolls, colorful drawings and maps.  A rug covers the floor near a fireplace in the adjacent corner.

The serenity of this chamber welcomes you, as the room is engulfed by the moonlight reaching through the intricately carved openings in the bark walls.  In one corner, a four-posted bed draped with a cockatrice feather comforter invites you to bask in the tranquility of your surroundings.  Below a painting on the opposite wall is an oak desk, covered with scrolls, colorful drawings and maps.  A rug covers the floor near a fireplace in the adjacent corner.

title: [Sylvanfair, Rose Garden]
description: The scent of a hundred different kinds of roses fills the air here.  Bushes and vines grafted into the Sylvanfair tree bear magical blooms of every imaginable color, throughout every season.  A large branch arches off to the west.

title: [Sylvanfair, Morning Glory Room]
description: A large window framed by delicately veined morning glory leaves floods the room with light and fresh air.  The walls are covered with carefully cultivated morning glories of delicate violet shades.  A large bed covered with a puma hide blanket beckons from behind a thin ora screen in one corner, and an instrument rack holding a lute and a harp stands against the wall next to a large bookcase.

title: [Moot Hall, Orchard]
description: A large garden stretches out beneath the shadow of Moot Hall, where rows and rows of apple trees flourish in abundance.  In the center of the orchard stands a speckled dark grey granite fountain surrounded by hand-carved red oak benches.  Thick stone walls rise up behind the building, shielding the area from the rest of the town, and a carved wooden door leads back inside.

title: [Moot Hall, Rooftop]
description: Dark slate runs across the roof of Moot Hall, providing solid footing and an impressive view of the town square below.  To the west, the great oak tree in the center of town rises up, partially obscuring the western side of the bazaar.

title: [Town Barracks, Inner Courtyard]
description: Stone walls wrap around to form a solid enclosure to the courtyard, the ground smooth and paved with dark cobblestones.  Barely visible beyond the thick iron gate stretches North Ring Road and an expanse of the palisades of Wehnimer's Landing.  A large two-story brick building dominates the far end of the courtyard, its roof topped with a black and grey flag.

title: [Wehnimer's, The Mews]
description: This narrow lane runs north to south, shaded by the narrow, unadorned buildings that loom on both sides of the rough paving stones.  The clatter of wagon wheels on cobbled streets and the jangling of iron-fitted harnesses echoes from the south, along with a scent of leather and livestock.

title: [ShadowGuard, South Courtyard]
description: The dank, musty smell of rotting vegetation pervades this area as death has taken hold.  Overgrown with weeds and uncontrolled, twisted plant life, the courtyard must once have been beautiful.  The crumbling remnants of a gatehouse tower, and occasional intact pieces of the southern wall, stand as a sad reminder of the former might of the fortress.

title: [ShadowGuard, Gatehouse Tower]
description: The bottom floor of the tower is strewn with the rotting remnants of an ancient wooden desk and several chairs.  The rusted remains of a large weapons rack sag against one wall.  The air is so damp the moisture is palpable, and moss covers much of the cracked stone walls and rotting furniture.  A dilapidated archway leads back to the courtyard.

title: [ShadowGuard, West Courtyard]
description: Though dead and withered, the crisp clean lines of the formal gardens are still clearly visible.  Bright white pebbled walkways cut a sinuous pattern through the decaying flora winding their way around the cathedral to the northeast.

title: [ShadowGuard, West Tower]
description: Several rusted-out metal cabinets lie overturned amongst piles of rubble, spilling a variety of antiquated weapons onto the dust-covered stone floor.  Deep cracks in the walls allow a slight breeze to enter, but the breeze does nothing to alleviate the heavy dampness in the air.  Strategically placed stones jut out from the curved walls to form a stairway leading to the level above.

title: [Shadowguard, East Courtyard]
description: Neglected gardens have overgrown their boundaries here, spilling out over the pebbled walkways.  Several rotting trellises, heavy with twisted blackened roses, have collapsed against the deteriorating walls.  A pair of glowing eyes peers from beneath the tangled mess.

title: [ShadowGuard, East Tower]
description: Circular stone walls surround a large pile of debris that dominates the center of the room.  The remains of a desk, chairs, and broken pottery make up the bulk of the pile, while a few rusting weapons lie discarded nearby.  A small stairway cut into the east wall leads upward.

title: [Shadowguard, North Courtyard]
description: Piles of stone and timber litter the courtyard.  To the south, crumbling walls extend from the rear of the cathedral, the skeletal remains of the keep that once stood here.  The outer wall has been reclaimed by nature to the east, while a small section still stands to the west.

title: [ShadowGuard, North Tower]
description: Dust lies heavily on the hard stone floor of the tower.  Curved walls rise high above to a rough plank ceiling.  An abandoned desk and two overturned chairs bear testimony to the tower's former use.

title: [Phoenix Annex, Willow Tree]
description: This quiet, leafy bower seems remote from the courtyard below.  The gentle swaying of the tree in the breeze and the susurration of the leaves is relaxing.  Peering down through the willow branches you can spy the natural pool below.

title: [Phoenix Annex, Natural Springs]
description: The small spring is lined with a brilliant array of colorful stones.  Exotic plants, carefully arranged to provide privacy, grow in profusion along the bank.  A tall willow tree leans gracefully over the spring, as if granting its blessing on the swimmers.  The bottom of the spring is lined with fine sand, oddly warm to the feet.  Air bubbles rush up from below, tickling the bare parts of your skin.  A small waterfall trickles musically down a jumble of rocks, and a small wooden fishing dock juts out from a sandy bank.

title: [House Phoenix, Observatory]
description: Here on the highest level of the building, most of the walls and the roof seem to be formed of a clear glasslike crystal that allows an almost unrestricted view of the sky above and the surrounding townscape.  Various instruments of observation and study stand on a raised platform in the middle of the room.  To the south is a hallway.

title: [House Phoenix, Waldo2's Chamber]
description: This room is decorated in muted earth tones, giving a feeling of peace and contentment.  Obviously, the owner wishes to relax, away from the strife and combat of the wilds.  A solid oak chair sits before an equally sturdy oaken desk.  A plain but comfortable bed is the room's only other furnishing.

title: [Talador, Silver Lane]
description: To the northeast and southeast the East Circle District opens up, lined with shops and colorful pavilions.  Sunlight gleams off the armor of the city's guards while they patrol the area.
To the northeast and southeast the Eastern Circle District opens up, lined with shops and colorful pavilions.  Moonlight gleams off the armor of the city's guards while they patrol the area.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southeast, south

title: [Charleia's Charms]
description: The interior of the wagon is lined with crowded shelves full of glowing mushrooms, casting the area in a dim greenish glow.  Positioned near a blackened iron cauldron, an ebonwood bookshelf creaks under the weight of a multitude of dusty spell tomes.  A glass-panelled armoire displays a variety of crystals and trinkets at the rear of the wagon.

title: [Jungle Room, Bathing Pool]
description: The warm soothing water relaxes your muscles and the scents of rose and cedar intermingle in the air, leaving you with a renewed spirit.  How refreshing!  Fresh water constantly trickles in from the mouth of a small marble fish statue.

title: [Silvergate, Jungle Room]
description: The warm humid air of this tropical retreat invites you to cast away your worries and cares.  Flowering vines creep up the carved posts of a four-poster bed which provides support for a canopy of rustling ferns.  Water trickles from a fountain, cunningly crafted to resemble a waterfall, and fills a small bathing pool near the fireplace.  Several colorful cushions are scattered on the floor near the hearth.

title: [Silvergate, Meditation Room]
description: Polished oak floors with an inlaid teak border add to the tranquility and elegance of the room.  Centered in the room is a large stone basin with fragrant white water lilies floating in crystal clear water.  Delicate white sheer drapes hang down from an elaborately carved teak canopy that spans the ceiling.  Meditation mats circle the water basin, and tiny crystal prisms hang at different heights from the canopy.

title: [Silvergate, 3rd Floor Hallway]
description: Thick carpeting muffles your footsteps and warms this room.  A small window in the western wall overlooks a courtyard far below and the forest beyond.  Simply furnished, there is a single table and a straight-backed chair resting at the window.  A wide carpeted staircase leads back to the lounge far below.

title: [Storage Hall]
description: The hall is dark, lit only by a guttering torch over each of the two doors and a beam of light pouring through a small hole in the wall.  The obsidian walls are unbroken by decorations, and any noises echo loudly off the stone.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Den]
description: Large bookcases, filled with ancient tomes all bound with dark purple seals, stretch from wall to wall.  In the center of the room is a large, circular fireplace, its iron curtain protecting the plush fur throws that are laid out before it.  Chairs set about two large lamp-lit mahogany tables provide a perfect place for late night studies.  About the room rest several large trophies, and a large portrait hangs above the bookcases.

title: [Bard Guild, Lower Hallway]
description: A short, low-lit hallway is lined with doors and openings, with heavy velvet drapes to the north that shield the corridor from the Feast Hall's din.  The walls of the corridor are paneled in dark wood, and a row of rectangular lanterns standing on either side of the aisle sheds soft light.  Each door is labeled.  A brass sign on an oak door reads 'Practice Room,' to the east is the 'Music Room,' and to the south is the 'Music Library.'
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, up

title: [Bard Guild, Practice Room]
description: The practice room is an oak-paneled chamber with a small hearth.  In the center sits a chair and accompanying music stand.  Opposite the hearth is a side table, offering a place to scribble notes or work on musical compositions.

title: [Guardian Keep, Kitchen]
description: Beneath overtones of woodsmoke, the air of the kitchen is peppered with delectable scents of roasting meat and baking bread.  In stark contrast to the symphony of scents, the kitchen is largely utilitarian.  Beyond a series of wide-bellied cast iron stewpots, wide countertops boasting neatly bunched vegetables devour much of its space.  Huge recesses in the walls host hearths cooking spitted velnalins and gaks.  A swinging oak door in the north wall stands opposite a smaller doorway to the south.

title: [Guardian Keep, East Hallway]
description: Sword aloft, a hulking Vaalor elf is remembered in statue at the end of the low-ceiling chamber.  Runners of golden and crimson velvet soften the tiled floors below, the hues reflecting in the burnished marble of the ceiling.  A lustrous mosaic-tiled arch gleams from the southern wall at the hallway's midpoint.  Near the corridor's end, the simple entrance to the armory and a swinging oak door heading into the kitchens stand opposite one another.

title: [The Demonwall]
description: A dry warm breeze moves over the wall's edge, bringing with it the faint stench of rotting flesh.  A flight of flat stone stairs descends down the side, leading to a cracked sprawl of land and Barret's Gorge to the north.

title: [Barret's Gorge, The Sprawl]
description: A huge flight of flat stone stairs ascends up to the top of the crumbling ramparts of the fabled Demonwall.  The wall itself stretches far and wide to both the east and west, each section disappearing further than the eye can see.

title: [Aelotoi Embassy, Receiving Room]
description: A set of broad mosaic stone steps sweeps down into the airy enclave which reaches exceedingly low depths.  Positioned directly at the bottom of the stairs, a sunny flaxen carpet leads to a great haon receiving hall table lined with backless silk-tufted chairs.  An intricate celestial marquetry composes the majority of the vast flooring, balancing with the smoothly carved pale limestone walls.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Linsandrych Var]
description: Polished cobblestones of the var glisten as the sunlight strikes their surfaces.  A thanot-beamed enclave stands to one side of the road, its silvery blue stone shimmering in the heat of the day.  To the other side, a tall, stone palisade encircles a secluded compound.  Flowering greenery grows about a crystal lantern that hangs from an ornately carved alabaster post.

title: [Fogardruh's Wagon]
description: The combined smells of oil, steam, and molten metal assault the senses, and the distinct sound of a hammer on anvil resounds from beyond a wrought invar door located near the back wall of this dimly lit sales floor.  Racks filled with merchandise are attended to by a pair of young dwarven clerks dressed in blacksmith's garb.  Opposite the invar door, a forged glaes ramp leads out.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Black Waters]
description: An algal mat covers the stretch of water just next to the shore, and further out, the water moves quickly, shifting and swirling, as the barely-there current carries it in a southwesterly direction.  Although clusters of cypress are visible further north, few trees are present here, the foliage instead dominated by wild brush.

title: [A Bone to Pick]
description: Gritty limestone steps descend into this ancient mausoleum, where the floor is scattered with a variety of bones; some human, others not.  Near an alcove shelf, some pitted brass hooks are suspended from a far, nearly intact wall, rising adjacent to a dark tunnel leading to the north and deeper within.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Seven Hexes]
description: A huge collection of charms and fetishes dangles from the bald cypress branches overhanging this spot.  Pale mist covers the shoreline, disappearing abruptly at the water's edge.  Lily pads cover the surface, their petals overlapping each other, their blossoms a pale purple color that is especially vivid in the dank surroundings.

title: [Sunken Mausoleum, Undercroft]
description: Torches, each lit with a dark violet flame, are affixed upon the granite walls.  Standing in the center of the undercroft is a limestone sarcophagus, which is surrounded by piles of rubble.  The smell of dried blood wafts throughout the tomb, becoming more potent toward the tunnel.  Along the northern wall, a twisting granite staircase leads up toward the surface.

title: [Sunken Mausoleam, Dead End]
[Sunken Mausoleum, Dead End]
description: Along the walls, a group of ebonwood coffins has been plundered, leaving only some skeletal remains.  The circular room is a dead end, and the only exit is the flight of steps leading back toward the front.  A rusted iron plaque, its surface barely legible, is hammered into the granite wall.

title: [Ancient Passage]
description: Grey, time-worn limestone walls provide a grim atmosphere to this wide hallway.  The high ceiling and thick layer of pale silt covering the floor provide hints that the passage may once have boasted a smooth, plaster veneer.

title: [Within the Snake]
description: Although carved from solid limestone, the walls, floor, and ceiling at the eastern end of the passage resemble the soft curves of the inside of a serpent's mouth.  A pair of crimson fangs curving up from the floor are visible just beyond the archway that forms the gaping maw.

title: [The Loot Cellar]
description: A set of glaes-paned lanterns are hung from the rafters of the pavilion overhead.  The room is hollowed out from a nest of gnarled cypress roots.  A dusting of pale green moss covers the ground.  At the northern end of the room is a plank ladder leading to a reinforced modwir trapdoor.

title: [Holly, Wood, And Vine]
description: Beams of white and red oak arch overhead forming the roof of this octahedral pavilion.  Large panels of gold and silver cotton are hung from the wooden framework, enclosing the space within the structure.  Garlands of holly and liana vine dangle from the oaken beams above and drape over a birch arch.  A carpet of pale green moss covers the floor of the pavilion.

title: [Fitzwobbin's, Inside the Beast]
description: Numerous pipes run in a confusing pattern over the walls and ceiling into a large iron box at the rear fo the chamber.  Two gears attached to the wagon's axles appear to be easily engaged with a nearby lever.  A small space in the center of the room serves as an obvious work area.

title: [Fitzwobbin's Figures, Show Room]
description: Some steel racks line the interior walls of the wagon, leaving little space for anything else.  Small wooden cabinets support a fold out countertop against the back wall, while a few iron rungs lead upwards to a circular steel hatch in the ceiling near the wagon's front.

title: [Basement, Cells]
description: A row of three iron-barred cells, one next to the other, line the western wall.  Across from the cells is a table holding a whip and a few scattered shackles.  Dark spots on the cold stone floor appear to be smears of dried blood.  Faint light spills into the area from the top of a narrow staircase.

title: [Li'aerion, Kitchens]
description: Polished white stone countertops laden with copper cookware are fitted along three sides of this room.  A wide copper vent extends from the ceiling, ending above a large fire pit and roasting spit.  Above the counters are shelves neatly filled with silver and gold serving trays, tea sets, plates, and goblets.  The center of the fourth wall is occupied by a small oak door, flanked on either side by wooden hooks hung with heavy linen aprons.

title: [A Dark Tunnel, Staircase]
description: It is very dark and cold here, and the steep stairs underfoot are very slippery.

title: [A Dark Tunnel, Staircase]
description: It is very dark and cold here, and the steep stairs underfoot are very slippery.
