title: [Mistydeep, Northern Strand]
description: While wider and slower to the north, here the Mistydeep River gathers itself to squeeze between steep, narrowing banks.  Gaining speed in its southward passage, the water surges over hundreds of rocky cascades.  Small pools eddy deceptively before overflowing into churning rapids.  Safe on the trunk of a fallen tree, a pudgy raccoon grasps some unknown morsel in its paws, dunking it daintily in the water between bites.
paths: Obvious paths: north, south, southwest, west, northwest, down
from.location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Underwater]
description: The Mistydeep seems particularly dark and deep at this point, its clear, cold waters flowing quickly by a few large boulders.  The shadowy forms of a few large fish making their way upstream are outlined against the sand below.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southeast, northwest, up
to.location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Northern Strand]
description: Wild geese congregate midstream, honking noisily at anyone or anything that comes near.  Upstream, a tree-covered isle parts the waters, its lush shore creating a haven for fish and small animals.  To the east, a wide game trail leads from the riverbank into the untamed weald.  Rustling brush is accompanied by a quick glimpse of something brown, though it moved far too quickly to identify with surety.  Across the river, the shore bends gently south, with boulders of varying size extending into the water.

Small bubbles break the surface of the water as fish come to the surface to feed.  Upstream, a tree-covered isle parts the waters, its lush shore creating a haven for fish and small animals.  To the east, a wide game trail leads from the riverbank into the untamed weald.  Rustling brush is accompanied by a quick glimpse of something dark, though it moved far too quickly to identify with surety.  Across the river, the shore bends gently south, with boulders of varying size extending into the water.
paths: Obvious paths: south, southwest, west, northwest, down
from.location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Underwater]
description: Massive boulders of dusky granite lie scattered like children's blocks along the bottom.  Deeply buried in the sand to the south, the boulders rise successively higher to the northwest, finally breaking the water's surface overhead.
paths: Obvious exits: north, south, west, up
to.location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Twelve Oaks Manor, Parlour]
description: Ivory crown molding joins cream-hued walls and the soaring vaulted ceiling.   An arched oak door stands to the side of a black marble fireplace, which is nestled into the western wall and has an ivy-etched mirror centered above it.  Facing the hearth is a plush floral-patterned couch framed by a set of petite lor end tables.  The northern wall boasts a series of floor-to-ceiling windows that look out onto the moonlit garden, broken only by a pair of multi-paned glass doors.  Along the eastern wall is a polished lor arch leading into the dining area.

title: [Twelve Oaks Manor, Library]
description: Well-oiled dark oak paneled bookcases form the walls of the spacious two story room.  Segmented floor-to-ceiling windows along the north wall provide a breathtaking view of the moonlit gardens.  The polished stained oak floor adds a stark contrast to the warm ivory rug, centered with an intricately carved ash table.  Several two-toned ivory and beige couches provide comfortable seating around a carved ivory limestone fireplace, which is centered along the western wall.  A spiral staircase leads up to the second floor walkway, providing access to the books above.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: This dark, cavernous room smells like a slaughterhouse.  Bodies in varying states of extended decomposition, from mummies to bare bones, litter the floor.  A dim light comes from a pot set high on the wall.  There is a dark hole in the wall here, which seems to lead upwards while gloomy passages lead away in three directions.

title: [Torture Chamber]
description: Gruesome instruments of torture fill this room, although most are now broken beyond repair.  The dampness of the castle walls here has promoted the growth of several molds, and a dank, musty smell hangs about the room.  The vague stench of death wafts up from cracks surrounding a trap door in the floor, filling you with dread.

title: [Baile Dragan, Courtyard]
description: In the center of the courtyard a white tower rises skyward, light flickering in the windows.  Mossy pathways meander among the quiet oak trees leading from door to door in the circular structure that encloses the area.  A small pond, its surface dotted with floating candles, is nestled near some flower patches.  Living sapling benches, formed by intertwining branches near a stone shrine, offer places to sit and enjoy the night air.  Somewhere nearby an owl hoots his nighttime refrain.

title: [Baile Dragan, Triskelion Hall]
description: This large, open room is filled with successively higher rows of polished ebonwood benches, supported at each end by heavy, dragon-shaped legs of cast silver.  The walls are hung with magnificent tapestries worked in silver thread on a black background.  Each life-sized panel depicts a scene of a mortal and a dragon in some sort of interaction.  At the front of the room is a large dais, behind which the Ord an Dragan standard is displayed.

title: [Oreina's Treetop]
description: A patchwork covering is perched precariously overhead, made of a myriad scraps of fabric and strung between branches with bits of twine.  The excess is left to fall in great swathes to enclose the round platform nestled in the cradle of several large branches, and miniscule tears and openings in the fabric allow in thin shafts of pale moonlight.  Smaller limbs and branches encircle the platform, while a narrow rope bridge leads deeper into the tree's canopy.

title: [Circle of Trees, Platform Level]
description: Travel to the next platform is blocked by an open space, and the single woven rope bridge that heads to the northwest seems to end at this platform.  The view straight down is obscured by many crisscrossing branches of the rosewood trees that grow in a cluster below, their bodies so intertwined as to almost form one giant tree.  The faint scent of wood smoke lingers in the air, and the gentle rustle of leaves is the only sound.

title: [Felthrop's Tent, Hidden Room]
description: Surrounded by earthen walls, this secret underground room smells of dirt and moisture, the air laden with dust and miniscule falling particles.  The only furnishings consist of a low bench and a large wooden chest with a broken lock.   Several candelabra have been stuck in the dirt walls, the candles casting their dancing light on the room, not quite eliminating the shadows at the edges.  Several wooden boards are set into one wall, creating a ladder of sorts.

title: [Felthrop's Tent, Fire and Ice]
description: An open window takes up the majority of the back wall, allowing ample moonlight as well as errant breezes to enter the room.  At opposing corners of the opening, a deep brawling bin and a ranged weapons crate rest against the amethyst silk wall.  In the center of the floor, an edged weapons rack displays additional wares, while a hanging wooden sign resides above.  Opposite the window, a silver-beaded curtain hangs in a doorway, the tiny silver orbs clicking together when disturbed by the wind.

title: [Cooper's, Secret Room]
description: This cool and pleasant room brings a calm smile to your lips.  It bears the clean, comforting scent of freshly worked wood, and the floor is covered with shavings of modwir, cedar, oak.  The walls are formed of long, vertical planks, fastened with pegs to the substructure and joined in a dovetailed, almost seamless fashion.  Great care and skill has gone into making this simple storage space.
from.location: Pan's Place, inside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Cooper's Shop, Workshop]
description: The crunch of wood shavings underfoot and the tangy scent of newly cut lumber indicate barrels are fitted and joined in this open workshop.  Mallets, chisels and hammers are neatly arranged in a tool chest on the floor.  Kegs in various states of completion surround you.

title: [Protect and Serve]
description: A crimson and gold wool rug, woven with the image of a fortress, stretches across the floor of the wagon.  A low wooden bunk over a wooden drawer with a gear for a handle is built into the rear of the wagon, reinforced with two thick steel chains that secure it to the wall.  Brightly colored tapestries line the walls above neatly organized workspaces that hold bits of leather, assorted metal rings and plates, and other materials used in armor manufacturing.  Nearly hidden behind a diminutive armoire inlaid with copper sprockets is a small wooden hatch that leads outside.

title: [Protect and Serve, Wagon Yard]
description: A gold-striped crimson canvas awning, supported by a pair of thin steel poles, stretches from the roof of the wagon, bathing the thick grass in cool shadow.  Several wooden crates are stacked to one side of a small wooden hatch.  At the edge of the yard stands a tiny portable forge with an iron anvil and a low worktable nearby.

title: [Coliseum, Southwest Corridor]
description: Polished stone walls reflect the light of a trio of steel-banded torches that has been inset into ornate brackets.  Centered over a brick-lined tunnel is a forest green banner that reads "Arena Entrance" embroidered in thick indigo thread.  An indigo banner over a forest green arch reads "Viewing Chamber" in elegant azure embroidery.

title: [Amphitheater of Kings]
description: Smooth stone walls encase this sunken chamber and faint, dark red stains mar the scorched stone floor.  Near the ceiling on one wall is a large window, providing a glimpse of the wall-hung tapestries in the room beyond.

title: [Coliseum, Southeast Corridor]
description: Polished stone walls reflect the light of a trio of steel-banded torches that has been inset into ornate brackets.  Centered over a brick-lined tunnel is a golden banner that reads "Arena Entrance" embroidered in thick ebon thread.  An ebon banner over a golden arch reads "Viewing Chamber" in elegant golden embroidery.

title: [Amphitheater of the Fallen]
description: Smooth stone walls encase this sunken chamber and faint, dark red stains mar the scorched stone floor.  Near the ceiling on one wall is a large window, providing a glimpse of the wall-hung tapestries in the room beyond.

title: [Coliseum, Northeast Corridor]
description: Polished stone walls reflect the light of a trio of iron-banded torches that has been inset into ornate brackets.  Centered over a brick-lined tunnel is a deep azure banner that reads "Arena Entrance" embroidered in thick flaxen thread.  A flaxen banner over an azure arch reads "Viewing Chamber" in elegant azure embroidery.

title: [Amphitheater of the Arkati]
description: Smooth stone walls encase this sunken chamber and faint, dark red stains mar the scorched stone floor.  Near the ceiling on one wall is a large window, providing a glimpse of the wall-hung tapestries in the room beyond.

title: [The Mage Dahcre Chamber]
description: High and airy, this elegant room seems designed for comfort and relaxation.  Several large cushions of the softest silk lie scattered before a white marble fireplace, above which is set a silver looking-glass framed by carvings of woodland sprites.  The carved sprites continue their frolic on a low bar to one side, which is flanked by twin blue and scarlet banners.  A moonglae opal medallion set above the entry arch glimmers in the light.

title: [Darkened Chamber]
description: A single glaesine sconce attached to the wall illuminates the small chamber, casting a fitfully flickering light across the room's few features.  Smooth, dark-veined granite walls rise into the shadowed darkness.  Dangling from a chain at one side of the room is a small mithglin ring.  At the far end of the chamber is a simple curtained opening.

title: [Cavern, Ritual Room]
description: The despanal-inlaid summoning circle dominates the center of the cavern.  Mottled veins of liquescent crimson stone bleed outward from the edges of the circle and snake toward the ceiling along the pale cavern walls.  Slick with condensation, hoary clumps of glowing lichen cast a murky green glow throughout the chamber.

The despanal-inlaid summoning circle dominates the center of the cavern.  Mottled veins of liquescent crimson stone bleed outward from the edges of the circle and snake toward the ceiling along the pale cavern walls.  The ophidian breaks in the rocks are continued through the side of the cave, where a small stream enters and exits the chamber with a subdued rushing sound that echoes off a small dock.  Slick with condensation, hoary clumps of glowing lichen cast a murky green glow throughout the chamber.

title: [Faendryl Enclave, Courtyard]
description: Symmetrical rows of lor trees stand as silver sentinels along a gravel pathway that broadens into a circular courtyard.  In the center of the yard, a pair of trees have grown together into a single towering tree, echoing the lofty reach of the alabaster spire rising to their north.

title: [Necropolis, Dark Sanctuary]
description: A towering sculpture in the likeness of Luukos dominates the sanctuary -- crafted from viridian marble, time has worn its way through the rock, causing severe damage.  Much of its left arm and shoulder lie strewn across the northern wall, entirely blocking off an archway.  Underneath the wreckage, a partially collapsed tunnel has been exposed.  A narrow chasm can be seen off to the west of an iron-hinged ebonwood door.

title: [Necropolis, Sunken Tunnel]
description: The unstable walls have buckled in several places, depositing large chunks of stone along the path and nearly blocking the way ahead.  Mounds of dirt and rubble cause the route through the tunnel to be more circuitous in order to avoid possibly creating a cave in.

title: [I Do Eclair!, Under the Floor]
description: Cramped and dimly lit, this small area is contained by lichen-covered stone walls and a swept dirt floor.  A hefty, dull black metal safe stands open across from a rickety wooden desk next to a set of steep stairs.

title: [I Do Eclair!, Back of Counter]
description: Empty plates and cups, most of them clean, are stacked on shelves beneath the counter.  Neatly labeled boxes and sacks of supplies are arranged on a wooden rack at the far end of the counter.  A bowl of milk, a blanket-filled wicker basket and a tangled ball of yarn occupy the farthest corner.

title: [Wounded for Wear, Foyer]
description: The floor is covered in a plush crimson carpet with a series of black stripes, and the walls of the shop are painted black, with splotches of red paint on them.  Nestled into the wall is a small dark hole that leads back to the swamp.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Black Waters]
description: The brackish water flows past the shoreline so slowly that floating debris makes nearly imperceptible progress.  A swath of flattened reeds and grasses leads from the water's edge to a raised berm of debris.  Remnants of a single broken eggshell are all that mark this as a now abandoned empty nest.

The brackish water flows past the shoreline so slowly that floating debris makes nearly imperceptible progress.  A swath of flattened reeds and grasses leads from the water's edge to a raised berm of debris.  Nestled just to the side of the detritus, a weathered plank footbridge leads over a narrow span of water.  Remnants of a single broken eggshell are all that mark this as a now abandoned empty nest.

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Black Lake]
description: This stretch of the lake spans from the cavern shore to a large block of limestone floating atop the water's surface.  Though it appears murky and dark, the lake's water is strangely silky, like a mixture of oil and satin that moves of its own accord against your skin.  Small bubbles float up from the depths, creating a burbling sound that disturbs the otherwise placid.  Opposite where the water swirls down into a churning river, the lake streches out into darkness.

title: [Underground Cavern]
description: Stalagmites jut out of the ground, paired with stalactites that splay out from the ceiling.  The water-glazed formations are arranged in arcing rows, lending the appearance of multiple gaping maws spread across the distance between a doorway and a vast, murky lake.  Small pools of clear water reflect the sputtering flames of torches that send shadows scurrying about in their flaring, haphazard light.  Below a gaping hole at the southern edge of the lake, the water gathers into a churning river.

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Geyser]
description: The temperature in this area is much cooler than the previous cavern, and dampness coats everything in the reach of a slick opening in the ground.  An opening in the ceiling appears to be a pathway out.  Adjacent a gaping hole in the wall, a massive rockslide blocks passage to the northeast.

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Black River]
description: Water rushes all around you, swiriling and splashing black liquid to and fro.  The current is particularly strong on the side nearest the open space of the cavern, visibly creating eddies that look as if they might suck you under.  The middle of the river, however, allows you to stay afloat and fight, though not easily, being pulled further downstream.  Opposite the slick rock ledge leading into the cavern, a rockslide rife with boulders and rocks of all sizes leads up to a massive hole in the wall.

title: [Ranger Guild, Nexus]
description: The spacious and airy chamber is carpeted in soft coyote hide, and oil lamps set between the doors on all four walls provide a gentle illumination.  Tapestries and large paintings cover the walls between the doors and windows.  Stairs carved from one of the tree's branches lead down, and a nearby ladder leads up.

title: [Ranger Guild, Office]
description: The small office is cozy and filled with maps and furnishing, but immaculately tidy.  Directly across the room from the door stands a large monir desk with papers, scrolls and various implements and ornaments all arranged neatly on its top.  A large fireplace dominates the wall to the right, the fire burning within providing plenty of light.  The walls are covered with maps, some depicting strange and faraway places, others very familiar areas.

title: [Zul Logoth, Cavern]
description: Stalagmites and stalactites are sporadically spaced within this large cavern.  Light illuminates the passageway to the northwest, casting long shadows on the ground from the various rock formations.  Patches of luminescent moss create tiny glowing points on the ceiling.

title: [Zul Logoth, Winding Tunnels]
description: Tunnels branch off in every direction.  Tiny, white-flecked fungi grow in clusters along the rocky floor.  Heavy footsteps echo from somewhere deeper in the underground network.

Several small puddles reflect the light of the resident phosphorescent moss.  Water occasionally drops from the ceiling, landing with an audible *plop*.  The air is slightly stagnant throughout the area.
Part of the wall has been chipped away at, an apparent attempt at creating yet another tunnel.  Slender stalactites hang low, covered with glowing, mottled green-blue moss.

A faint scent of salt clings to the air, a result of the natural deposits in the rock and dripping water.  Grooves in the floor, obscured by the darkness, create a hazard for those wandering these tunnels.
Diffuse light emanates from the bluish-green moss thriving within the confines of the tunnels.  Roughly scrawled upon the rocky walls are several arrows, each pointing to a different passageway.
Snaking paths have been cleared through the rock, crisscrossing at this juncture.  A faint coat of slime covers several of the rocks here.
Clusters of reddish crystals sparkle among the rocky walls.  Several of the stalagmites have had their tops hewn off, with the rubble strewn across the uneven floor.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Ranger Guild, The Circle]
description: Deep furrows in the silvery bark of the massive oak tree wind their way along its trunk, forming strange, intertwined patterns upon the surface of the ancient tree.  Large roots sprawl along the ground, their bark riddled with a faint sheen of moss.  The rest of the area is covered in pale green grass, the tiny blades waving in the breeze slowly.

title: [Massive Oak, Cozy Crooks]
description: The central trunk ascends high into the sky, and a variety of huge branches arc off in all different directions -- each curved and sporting a thick cushion of leaves for relaxing and surveying the surrounding landscape.  Light filters down in soft waves, the harsh glare of the sun broken into refreshing spots of warmth mingled with patches of cool shade.  The faint trill of birds can occasionally be heard as they hop from branch to branch and disappear high up in the bough.

title: [Ranger Guild, The Circle]
description: Long tendrils of hanging moss drape from the higher branches of the massive oak tree, deep silvery specks hiding within their soft recesses.  Blades of long grass rustle underfoot, their diminutive green forms complemented by random patches of wildflowers and colorful weeds of every type.  Several roots rise high into the air here, allowing one to sit and gaze upon the scenery.

title: [Massive Oak, Cozy Crooks]
description: The central trunk ascends high into the sky, and a variety of huge branches arc off in all different directions -- each curved and sporting a thick cushion of leaves for relaxing and surveying the surrounding landscape.  Light filters down in soft waves, the harsh glare of the sun broken into refreshing spots of warmth mingled with patches of cool shade.  The faint trill of birds can occasionally be heard as they hop from branch to branch and disappear high up in the bough.

title: [Ranger Guild, The Circle]
description: A tiny stream flows through the forest of roots from the massive oak tree, the glimmering waters forming a small pool amid a circle of grey rocks.  Small wildflowers grow in between the gaps of the rocks, and the deep blackness of the pool is broken only by the faint ripples of the stream from above.  The hanging moss is particularly thick here, providing an intimate, tranquil atmosphere.

title: [Massive Oak, Cozy Crooks]
description: The central trunk ascends high into the sky, and a variety of huge branches arc off in all different directions -- each curved and sporting a thick cushion of leaves for relaxing and surveying the surrounding landscape.  Light filters down in soft waves, the harsh glare of the sun broken into refreshing spots of warmth mingled with patches of cool shade.  The faint trill of birds can occasionally be heard as they hop from branch to branch and disappear high up in the bough.

title: [Ranger Guild, The Circle]
description: The overhanging moss and drooping tree branches of the massive oak tree thin out a bit, allowing one to gaze down over the surroundings from atop the large hill.  Forests spread for miles beyond a small meadow at the base of the hill, and the landscape is dotted with clusters of wildflowers of every hue imaginable.  A few weathered grey stones peek out from the earth, offering up a pleasant place to sit and admire the view.

title: [Massive Oak, Cozy Crooks]
description: The central trunk ascends high into the sky, and a variety of huge branches arc off in all different directions -- each curved and sporting a thick cushion of leaves for relaxing and surveying the surrounding landscape.  Light filters down in soft waves, the harsh glare of the sun broken into refreshing spots of warmth mingled with patches of cool shade.  The faint trill of birds can occasionally be heard as they hop from branch to branch and disappear high up in the bough.

title: [Ranger Guild, The Circle]
description: A tangle of massive roots winds its way along the ground here, providing a shady haven speckled with spots of refreshing sun.  The area is a veritable garden -- flowers of every hue and type grow from the moss-laden ground, their florid hues set upon a backdrop of drab grey-greens of the large tree.  The girth of the tree provides a natural fence for the plants, their forms curving around the vivid petals in a gentle embrace.

title: [Massive Oak, Cozy Crooks]
description: The central trunk ascends high into the sky, and a variety of huge branches arc off in all different directions -- each curved and sporting a thick cushion of leaves for relaxing and surveying the surrounding landscape.  Light filters down in soft waves, the harsh glare of the sun broken into refreshing spots of warmth mingled with patches of cool shade.  The faint trill of birds can occasionally be heard as they hop from branch to branch and disappear high up in the bough.

title: [Ranger Guild, The Circle]
description: The gnarled bark of the massive oak is quite visible here, its huge boles and knots covered with a faint green coating of soft moss.  A variety of hanging moss has also made its home upon the trees branches, the tendrils of darker green swaying gently in the breeze.  Leaves litter the ground, their mottled brown hue mingling with the lush verdant surroundings.

title: [Massive Oak, Cozy Crooks]
description: The central trunk ascends high into the sky, and a variety of huge branches arc off in all different directions -- each curved and sporting a thick cushion of leaves for relaxing and surveying the surrounding landscape.  Light filters down in soft waves, the harsh glare of the sun broken into refreshing spots of warmth mingled with patches of cool shade.  The faint trill of birds can occasionally be heard as they hop from branch to branch and disappear high up in the bough.

title: [Ranger Guild, Foyer]
description: Modwir posts and beams are a darker accent to the white oak walls of this open room.  An undyed wool rug covers the sanded floorboards and benches of pine, teak, and modwir, elegant in their simplicity, rest near the door.  The clink of glasses issues from beyond the swinging doors to the west.

title: [Ranger Guild, Front Porch]
description: Plain cotton cushions cover the sanded maoral planks in lieu of chairs.  Wind chimes of wood and beaten brass turn in the breeze and add their gentle harmony to the atonal, yet tranquil music of nature.  To your south, the pavilion rises above the treetops, its banners brilliant against the cloudless sky.

title: [Ancient Keep, Office]
description: Long, twisting veins of mithril and rhimar entwine around each other across the circular room's ceiling.  Several rectangular cubbyholes line the walls, each containing an intricately carved ice sculpture within.  Presiding over the center of the office is a large mahogany chair cushioned with rich leather, with an elegant mahogany desk behind it.  Framed with etched rhimar, an oak-bound door leads back out.

title: [Ancient Keep, Foyer]
description: Circular in shape, the floor is completely made from square-cut sections of black marble.  Large, blackened marble pillars line the walls, ending with a domed glass ceiling high overhead.  A narrow gap on the far side of the room leads to a sweeping stairwell with a mithglin-plated door beneath it.

title: [Rone Academy, Cleric's Vestry]
description: Marble flagstones separate walls lined with cabinets filled with vestments and shelves lined with prayer books, while a sky-lit cathedral ceiling provides excellent acoustics for the practice of liturgy and chant.  In the exact center of the room is a podium supporting a large volume.  Along one wall is a set of material-laden shelves and a fel prie-dieu.

title: [Rone Academy, Cathedral]
description: Moonlight floats down through tall, stained-glass windows from the gabled ceiling of the Cathedral.  Elevated by a two-step platform, the altar is located in the middle of the rectangular cathedral and circled by wooden chairs padded with soft material for comfort.  The cream colored marble floor shines as if newly polished.  To the right of the altar is the ambo, where sacred scrolls are placed.

Sunlight streams through tall, stained-glass windows from the gabled ceiling of the cathedral.  Elevated by a two-step platform, the altar is located in the middle of the rectangular cathedral and circled by wooden chairs padded with soft material for comfort.  The cream colored marble floor shines as if newly polished.  To the right of the altar is the ambo, where sacred scrolls are placed.

title: [Sacred Grove]
description: The branches here have been trained to grow upward and inward, creating a living steeple of limbs and leaves.  In a zig-zag pattern beneath the peak, strings of spherical white paper lanterns dangle, though they are little more than decoration as dappled sunlight spills through the canopy.  A flat, woven basket of vines sits in the cradle of three limbs, and a pair of shelves are formed by densely braided branches.

The branches here have been trained to grow upward and inward, creating a living steeple of limbs and leaves.  In a zig-zag pattern beneath the peak, strings of spherical white paper lanterns dangle, filling the space with an abundance of warm, golden light.  A flat, woven basket of vines sits in the cradle of three limbs, and a pair of shelves are formed by densely braided branches.

title: [Circle of Trees, Platform Level]
description: Travel to the next platform is blocked by an open space, and the single woven rope bridge that heads to the northwest seems to end at this platform.  The view straight down is obscured by many crisscrossing branches of the rosewood trees that grow in a cluster below, their bodies so intertwined as to almost form one giant tree.  The faint scent of wood smoke lingers in the air, and the gentle rustle of leaves is the only sound.

title: [Black Wolves Manor, Foyer]
description: Scenes detailing the history of the Black Wolves Clan are proudly portrayed in magnificent oil paintings that line the walls.  The center of the ceiling houses a rounded crimson skylight that bears the silhouette of a howling wolf.  Moonlight penetrates the translucent image, casting the Black Wolves seal faintly onto the white marble floor below.  Bronze lanterns hang in pairs down the wide hallway, and a few armchairs have been arranged around a small table.

title: [Black Wolves Manor, Back Yard]
description: Tiny motes of light flash aimlessly as fireflies gather about the landscape.  Two lofty trees stand on either side of the lawn as they guard over a freshwater pond between them.  An ancient ironwood prevails in the eastern half, while a stately haon tree spreads its boughs across the lawn's western side.  A stone path wanders through the yard, curving alongside a large fallen branch under the ironwood, before it reaches a low dock jutting over the pond.

title: [The Oubliette]
description: Dust motes dance in a beam of light that illuminates the seal of the Black Wolves which is set in the center of the rough stone floor.  The faint crackle of magic hovers over a tangle of broken weapons and shattered armor next to a long table placed under some low-hanging shelves.  A painted mural depicting a flight of dragons soaring through a twilight sky climbs the granite walls of the circular chamber, ending at an iron grate set high above.

title: [Defender Hall, Auditorium]
description: Directly across from the entryway stands a prominent rounded dais set off by an elegant tapestry on the wall behind it.  Ebonwood benches are staggered downwards to the dais curving in a semi-circle to provide a clear view of the speakers.  Trails of crimson carpet line the steps and aisles of a pale grey marble floor, granting quiet and safe travel through the auditorium.  Brushed silver oil lamps encircle the room and reflect their light off the thick glass panels that arch up to form a high domed ceiling.

title: [Krolvin Warship, Second Deck]
description: Salt, rust, and grime cover most of the portside wall's solitary porthole, although one spot has been smudged to relative cleanness to allow a small band of light to filter into the dusty companionway.  Rags litter the deck just beneath the porthole, some blackened with tar that has hardened to thumb-sized nodules.
from.location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Great Western Sea]
description: The icy, dark blue water of the Northern Waves stretches out around you in every direction.  Rippling waves, some topped with whitecaps, chop up the surface and make it difficult for you to tread water.  The triple masts of the krolvin warship tower over the much smaller schooner.  You notice that a ladder extends down from the schooner's deck to the east.
to.location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Black River, Pool]
description: Gently swirling through the water, the current here is subtle, the river spreading its fingers out into a relatively calm pool before picking up speed at the far end, where it seemingly disappears into a black void.  Suffusing shifting areas of the otherwise inky black water, a glowing grate and the dim, undulating luminesence of tiny black, sinuous shapes swarming around in the water illuminates your immediate vicinity.  A small ledge juts out from slick walls rising up in every direction.

title: [Black River, Ledge]
description: Jutting out of one of the slick earthen walls and over the inky black pool of water, the spacious ledge sits at a slight angle.  Small cracks in the wall splinter in such a way as to create several natural niches.  The sounds of dripping water and the occasional whistling of gusts of wind mix unrythmically with the flow of the river water.

title: [Underground Tunnels, Rubble]
description: The surrounding rubble is damp, with little pools of water scattered between and atop various boulders and clusters of rocks, as well as a spattering of dead fish.  Trickles of black water cascade down from above, sourced from the almost invisible flow of a water snaking into a volomnious black void overhead.  Abutting where the water above ostensibly falls in heavy sheets when the void is not present, the wall has eroded away, leaving an opening where the rock has fallen in on itself and now provides egress.

Pounding down from above, a rapidly rushing waterfall falls in heavy sheets, creating a shin-deep turbulent pool of water, large boulders and clusters of rock jutting from below the surface.  Before continuing on its way downstream in a miniature flood, the inky black water fades in color and visual texture to the normalized murk of the Locksmehr River.

title: [Black River, Ledge]
description: Jutting out of one of the slick earthen walls and over the inky black pool of water, the spacious ledge sits at a slight angle.  Small cracks in the wall splinter in such a way as to create several natural niches.  The sounds of dripping water and the occasional whistling of gusts of wind mix unrythmically with the flow of the river water.

back_command: ;e line = fput "search" until line =~ /You discover a shallow crevice while searching the area!/;move 'go crevice'

title: [Lich's Landing, Specter Lane]
description: A small well rises up from the broken and uneven cobblestone, and a trio of decaying goblin zombies stand around it.  Blood oozes up out of the brick-lined well and the zombies cup their hands, eagerly drinking the crimson fluid.

title: [Underground Cavern]
description: Steeped in the pale glow of wisps of light clustering around several low-hanging drapery stalactites, the broad space is peppered with long rows of small dog-tooth stalagmites that pop up from the ground.  The maw-like divisions span between the edge of the cavern and a huge wooden palisade wall.  Settled near the palisade is an unnaturally flat boulder partially encircled by a trio of red velvet couches.  Riddled with the scent of death and decay, the air is crisp and cool.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Cesspool]
description: The floor of this putrid pit is quaggy and wet beneath about three feet of liquid sewage.  A few roots stick out from the tall dirt walls, covered in slick sludge.  A wet and rotting rope dangles over the side from above, where a shaft of light descends through a small overhead circle.

title: [Abandoned Building]
description: Not a single piece of furniture is left in this dusty room.  A splintered crate filled with random litter sits against one wall, beneath a cracked and dirty window.  The air holds a foul, musty odor that emanates strongly from the piles of rat droppings located in the shadowy corners.

title: [Sea of Fire, The Hammer]
description: A narrow pathway of sawtoothed stone curves up the base of the gargantuan spire, beginning at a rocky outcropping near the base and rising toward the formation's flaring head.  Although ragged and sharp-edged, the path ascends too evenly to be entirely natural.  It proceeds past colorful swirls on the hammer's face, and these, at least, are certainly not the work of a mortal hand.

title: [Sea of Fire, The Hammer's Base]
description: The true and incredible scope of the hammer-shaped spire of rock is apparent when viewed from the ragged terrain at its base.  It stretches up into the sky, many times the height of a man, as colorful and beauteous as it is deadly.  Lying amidst the jagged stones is a pile of sun-bleached bones, though whether the remains are an offering or merely evidence of an unwary traveler is unclear.

title: [Delirium Manor, Workshop Entry]
description: Dimly lit and musty smelling, this area is evidently not intended for guests.  The wide-open space appears to be roughly the size of the manor, but visible areas are neatly sectioned-off, each serving different functional purposes.  A massive chalkboard contains scrawled notes and drawings, most of which are half-erased.

title: [Delirium Manor, Pantry]
description: Set beneath a narrow window, the shelving and racks in this little pantry are similar to any other.  The contents, however, are not.  Front and center is a basket of hands, though it is unclear whether they are real or manufactured.  Propped up heads, turned to face a panelled wall, are spaced across the lowest shelf.  Alongside the peculiar array are fruits, vegetables, and a few sacks of grain.

title: [Delirium Manor, Upstairs]
description: A large, rectangular oil painting, framed in gold-leafed dried noodles, dominates the wall space at the top of the stairs.  Creaky floorboards sound an alert with the passing of each resident or guest.  A long, carpeted hallway extends off to the north and a shorter one leads to the south.

title: [Delirium Manor, Entry Hall]
description: Alternating tiles of black and white marble, though elegant in design, give a whimsical welcome with chalked barefoot footprints marching across every other tile.  Thick arrows scrawled with various words serve as directional guides to other areas, and a grand staircase leads to the manor's upper floors.

title: [Hendoran Outpost, Rooftop]
description: Stone ramparts line the entire perimeter of the rooftop, each section evenly spaced and fortified to allow equal protection and a staging ground for archers.  Rising from the center of the area is a crisp silver flag emblazoned with a silver phoenix and it flaps with the slightest of wind.  Beyond the highest point of the outpost, the grasslands stretch out far to the south before they disappear into the forest, and the palisade walls and buildings of Wehnimer's Landing expand to the north.

Stone ramparts line the entire perimeter of the rooftop, each section evenly spaced and fortified to allow equal protection and a staging ground for archers.  Rising from the center of the area is a crisp silver flag emblazoned with a blue phoenix and it flaps with the slightest of wind.  Beyond the highest point of the outpost, the grasslands stretch out far to the south before they disappear into the forest, and the palisade walls and buildings of Wehnimer's Landing expand to the north.

title: [Outpost, Inner Courtyard]
description: An imposing stone tower stands at the center of the inner courtyard, taking up the majority of the space.  Similar to the build of the rest of the outpost, the windows of the tower are narrow and better designed for arrows and defense than to offer light and a scenic view.  A wing extends from the tower's north side and soldiers continually file northward back and forth from it.

title: [Instrumental Interlude, Den]
description: The sound of water flow is loud here, echoing in layers to form a constant ambient rushing noise.  The embers from a long dead fire are scattered across the stone floor, originating from a ring of stones off in one corner.  A rotting bedroll in another corner has been gnawed on by several generations of rats, their feces and bones littering the moldering cloth.  From a niche in the wall, a lone candle illuminates much of the small room, leaving only the tunnel leading out to remain in the shadows.

title: [Instrumental Interlude, Tunnel]
description: The passage is almost completely dark, only illuminated by the light from the candles that filters in through the mouth of the tunnel.  A faint trickle of water can be heard from somewhere in the back of the room, the sound reverberating in the small space.  Just within the dim pool of light, a slatted wooden crate rests on its side, its contents threatening to spill out onto the stone floor.

title: [Pan's Place, Smuggler's Cavern]
description: The faint scent of sea air suggests the far end of this tunnel opens somewhere along Darkstone Bay, but only someone who knew the path well would brave the branching passageways.  A subterranean waterfall conceals a dogleg turn that widens out into a natural chamber.  Within the vaulted chamber, sealed display cases hold delicate treasures, while gold and silver baubles cover the floor in glittering drifts.  A dip in the floor holds a pool of coins that would be deep enough for swimming if the pit were filled with water.

title: [Pan's Place, Hidden Garden]
description: A constellation of candles in punched metal holders illuminates the narrow garden beside the cooper's shop and the brewery, dappling the grey field stone path and sparkling off the water of a winding stream.  The stream traces the course of the Locksmehr River in miniature, its banks verdant with native rushes and ferns.  A stately oak tree surrounded by a collection of exotic plants stands in the west where Wehnimer's Landing would be on the real river.  To the east, a somnolent buzz points the way to a hidden apiary.

title: [Mistydeep, South of Ravelin]
description: A raucous raven call reverberates through the treetops, its point of origin hard to discern.  Directly southeast, a large island splits the flow of the Mistydeep River.  The western branch runs wide, swift, and deep while its other half progresses at a more leisurely pace, skimming small sandy shoals.  On both sides, clear pebbled basins provide hiding places for crafty fish at the river's bottom.  Far above, a dark granite tor rises sharply from the island's heavily-wooded heart.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south, northwest, down
from.location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Underwater]
description: Several large boulders rising up from the sandy bottom dominate this stretch of the riverbed, rising far enough up to be a hazard to navigation without breaking the surface.  The algae and moss that have taken up residence there serve, in turn, as host to schools of minnows that nibble at their edges with dainty jabs.
paths: Obvious exits: southeast, southwest, northwest, up
to.location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, South of Ravelin]
description: To the northwest, a sprinkling of homes can be spotted among the assorted hardwoods, but here, the river glides past patches of pristine wilderness.  The howl of a wolf resounds somewhere in the distance, yet two egrets wading on stilt-like legs at the shore seem unperturbed.  To the south, a large shape looms in the midst of the river.
paths: Obvious paths: south, southwest, west, northwest, down
from.location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Underwater]
description: The channel of the river runs very deep here, the sand at its bottom difficult to see even though the water is remarkably free of sediment.  A flick of motion deep below suggests that some of the larger fish on the river enjoy this benthic solitude.
to.location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Ravelin]
description: Along this stretch, the roots of several trees lie exposed where soil has been eroded by the river.  In the midst of one such root cluster, a turtle floats serenely, only its head and upper shell exposed.  Further along, a large oak tilts precariously out over the water, clinging desperately to its worn away foundation.  Some enterprising individual has taken advantage of the tree's situation by attaching a rope swing to one of the stouter branches.
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest, down
from.location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Underwater]
description: The deep, clear waters of the Mistydeep filter the bright sunlight into ever-changing ripples along the sand and rocks that line the riverbed.  An eel peers out from its rocky lair, poised to strike at any fish that has the misfortune to pass by.
to.location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Ravelin]
description: Here, the Mistydeep slows its pace as it meanders through a quiet community.  Homes blend in with the surrounding foliage as if part of the forest itself.  Propped in the fork of a tree, a fishing pole leans out over the water, its line and cork float bobbing gaily in the current.  On the other side of the river, a pebbled shoal gives way to a marshy area where dragonflies dart about a tall stand of cattails.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, northwest, down
from.location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Underwater]
description: The chilly waters of the Mistydeep run swiftly at this depth, scouring clean the pale sand below.  Dark piscene forms lurk at vision's edge, but they keep their distance, making identification impossible.
to.location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Upper Reaches]
description: The water here is a pleasant dichotomy of quiet stillness and swirling agitation as a row of rocks dams the majority of the river's flow.  A few surging rivulets manage to break free, streaming in to fill this kidney-shaped depression.  A stone shelf beneath the rocky barrier allows those who perch there to experience leisurely water-massages.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, down
from.location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Underwater]
description: The sparking water of the Mistydeep River runs deep, dark, and fast over the clean sand.  Large gneiss boulders provide a refuge from the swift current for smaller denizens of the river, who dart in and out among the grasses that grow there.
to.location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Bard Guild, Corridor]
description: The hall stops before a large oak door, with a second almost identical door to the west.  To the east, a flight of steps descends a short distance to a landing below, where a brightly embroidered cloth banner over the doorway reads "Guild Office."

title: [Bard Guild, Practice Room]
description: The practice room is small, its walls paneled in dark wood that enhances the quiet ambiance.  The scent of aged wood and years of polish hang heavily in the air, paired with a slight tinge of mustiness, the trademark aroma of older buildings.  Other than a small hearth with a carved mantel on the south wall, the chamber's only furnishings are a chair and a music stand with a lyre-shaped top.

title: [Manor House, Sunken Tub]
description: The blue and green mosaic tiles lining the tub are magnified beneath the water and sparkle as rays of silver moonlight pierce the shallow water.  Wisps of steam rise lazily around you, creating a foggy haze on the cut-crystal spigots and the polished silver spout.  Nothing but the distant sounds of katydids disturbs the quiet in this tropical retreat.

title: [Manor House, Master Bath]
description: A substantial circular wall of rounded river rocks joined by smooth grey mortar provides privacy around this spacious bath.  No roof or overhead covering has been added however, leaving an open air feel and a view of the starry night sky.  A sunken tub, lined in smooth glass tiles of green and blue hues, commands the central location and provides occupants an unobstructed view while gazing upward from its depths.

title: [Furryfoot Woad, Clearing]
description: The small hill gives way to a sudden cutoff as it approaches the swiftly flowing stream below.  Verdant shrubs and brush grow from the cliff face below, nestled into the gnarled roots of the large, towering trees along the hill's edge.  Brightly colored pink ginger blossoms bloom from a number of niches in the tree roots.  A three-masted ship is beached next to the hill and the jungle has begun to claim the boat for itself.  The captain's balcony at the back of the boat is quite close to the cliff face.

title: [The Wave, Captain's Balcony]
description: The small balcony at the rear of the ship is constructed from painted modwir and maoral.  Enclosing the length of the balcony, a carved modwir railing provides a view of the verdant hillside nearby.  A woven acantha-fiber hammock is strung from a hook on the wall and the edge of the railing.  A glass-paneled lantern hangs from another hook on the wall of the ship, next to a glass-paneled bright green door.

title: [Inside Weffinait's Wagon]
description: The inside of this large wagon is even more spacious than it appears from the outside.  A long wooden counter stretches the length of the interior, with packed shelves behind it, reaching from floor to polished wood ceiling.  Boxes upon boxes of wares are stacked neatly in the corners, each with its contents labeled by a clear hand.  A set of stairs leads back outside.

title: [Imflass and Dragonstail]
description: Most of the homes here are shuttered, their doors and windows closed tight.  Though most are sized for dwarves, a few of the homes are far larger, with doorways fit for a giant.

title: [Lich's Landing, Corpse Row]
description: Pale fog hugs the ground, obscuring the road as you pass.  Wispy tendrils of white smoke coil up from the mist, snaking around the numerous corpses staked along the path.  Periodically, the shrill wail of a banshee can be heard from within a tall black crystal tower that rises up at the end of the lane.

title: [Banshee Tower, First Floor]
description: Smooth, crystal black walls form a circular chamber of the first floor of the tower.  The murky opaque, barely translucent surface of the walls allows only the slightest, yet blurred view of the road outside.

title: [East Feywrot, Deep Water Dock]
description: Brightly lit glass globed lanterns cast a soft glow across the surface of the dock and the rippling waters beyond.  Remnants of mooring lines are threaded through heavy iron rings at the edge of the dock, but no vessel appears in sight.

title: [East Feywrot, Dune's End]
description: A series of freshly whitewashed planks form a steep stairway connecting the far end of the pine walkway to a sturdy and spacious dock jutting out across a deep inlet at the river's edge.  Swirls and eddies in the current below indicate a somewhat greater depth to the river at this point than that found farther away from the main channel.  A luminous moon, high overhead, casts soft reflections of shimmering gold flecks across the rippling surface.

title: [Caligos Island, Pier]
[Caligos Isle, Pier]
description: The sturdy pier stands ready to accomodate visitors arriving from, or embarking to, the mainland.  Resting on raised pillars anchored firmly in the substrate below, the terminal end stretches far enough off shore to reach deep water at low tide.  A small grey shanty with pristine white trim is affixed near the stairs, held fast with heavy linked chains.

title: [Caligos Isle, Dockside Stairway]
description: Traversing the steep slope, either toward, or away from, the water is equally treacherous, with loose scree and jagged rocks to either side of the walkway.   Frantically swaying brass lanterns illuminate a large dock below, as it rises and falls in tempo with the waves.  Salt spray rhythmically buffets this section of the stairway, making the footing slick and vision even more difficult in the fog encumbered, nightime environs.

Traversing the steep slope, either toward, or away from, the water is equally treacherous, with loose scree and jagged rocks to either side of the walkway.   A large dock below rises and falls in tempo with the waves, straining against its mooring chains with each passing swell.   Salt spray rhythmically buffets this section of the stairway, making the footing slick and vision difficult.

title: [Caligos Isle, Eastern Slope]
description: A long-abandoned lighthouse waits just offshore, silhouetted in the darkness against the silvery white, moonlit horizon.  Its carved, stone block walls rise sharply from its forgotten perch on a jagged, black shoal.  Centuries of buffeting winds and battering seas have not diminished the fortitude of this silvery grey sentinel to remain at its post, standing guard over no one at all.

A long-abandoned lighthouse waits just offshore, silhouetted against the eastern horizon.  Its carved, stone block walls rise sharply from its forgotten perch on a jagged, black shoal.  Centuries of buffeting winds and battering seas have not diminished the fortitude of this silvery grey sentinel to remain at its post, standing guard over no one at all.

title: [Savor Your Magic, Stick]
description: Sanded planks of blonde oak are branded with a variety of moons, stars, and celestial markings from one wall to the next.  Draping from a polished globe of brass in the center of the ceiling, swathes of sky blue chiffon billow down and connect in narrow strips to the four corners of the room.  A curved archway is nestled between dual brass racks displaying wares and a glass display case is centerpoint to the entry door.

title: [The Abandoned Waters]
description: Refracted light from above dances like a thousand shimmering prisms cast across a long, black sandbar.  With a swoosh, energetic waves sweep over you and head off toward a nearby shore.  Pieces of broken coral mixed with bits of driftwood appear to swim away in tandem.

title: [The Abandoned Waters]
description: Clumped strands of dark green seaweed float through the murky waters and appear as schools of fish until a glimmer of light from above shows their true form.  Occasional heaving surges in the ocean shift everything in a rhythmic back-and-forth motion.
paths: Obvious paths: north, west, northwest, up, down

title: [The Abandoned Waters]
description: Clumped strands of dark green seaweed float through the murky waters and appear as schools of fish until a glimmer of light from above shows their true form.  Occasional heaving surges in the ocean shift everything in a rhythmic back-and-forth motion.
paths: Obvious paths: north, west, northwest, up, down

title: [The Abandoned Waters]
description: Chilling you to the bone, a steady rush of icy water pierces your skin.  Endless blackness is broken only by tiny indigo twinkling in a short black sandbar nearby, the grains and oceanic debris upon it somehow glinting of their own accord in this pitch darkness of the deep.  A sudden rush of warmth from somewhere over your head is countered by a return to near-arctic temperatures as the water surrounding you shifts and resettles.
paths: Obvious paths: south, southwest, west, up

title: [Hideaway Cavern]
description: Rocky walls consisting of dark shale in some areas and limestone in others spread all around in this cozy space.  A diminutive worktable, its surface covered in dust and ashes, holds a handful of blades sans hilts, some stained with sanguine and all wrought with cracks through their metal makeup.  Clearly ready for display and sale, a separate collection of blades, each finely crafted into a dagger and fully intact, dangles from a braided black rope that splays across the length of the area.

title: [Wrong Turn Tavern]
description: Built into the rock face, the derelict tavern is relatively bare, with only a handful of slipshod tables and chairs tucked under funnel-shaped glass lamps hanging from the craggy ceiling.  Cluttered on one side with six tall stools, a rough-edged oak bar is covered in a milky film, and the other side is entirely bereft of clean glassware and -- perhaps the reason for the general lack of patrons -- liquor.  Middling circular holes that serve as windows are cut into the rock and offer a view of the seascape to the east.

title: [Siren's Call, Cellar]
description: A diamond-nooked cellarette spans the entire back wall of this small room, and the shoulders and necks of wine bottles peek out from its depths.  A sparse few of the nooks are bereft of bottles, but are filled all the same by webbed tunnels woven by spiders or random bits of miscellany.  Underfoot, the uneven stone floor is solid, and every sound, no matter how slight, rebounds endlessly.

title: [Siren's Call, Mezzanine]
description: Open to the tavern's interior on one side and the downward slope of the mountain on the other, the mezzanine is buffeted by cool, soft breaths of air stirred by waves breaking on the shore far below.  Half of the sheltering overhang is an outcropping of rock, while the rest is a retractable oilcloth canopy in a deep shade of blue.  Each of the canopy's supports are moored in sculpted stone planters carved out from the rocky floor.  A narrow stairway leads down to the bar.

title: [Catacombs, Dark Tunnels]
description: The walls of the tunnel are still fairly intact here, with little sign of decay.  A draft of stale air wafts up from a shaft in the center of the floor.  The tattered remains of a rope cling to a small ring in the ceiling, poised directly over the shaft.

title: [Catacombs, Collapsed Tunnel]
description: Most of the roof has collapsed here, totally blocking travel farther east.  Water enters from the western tunnels and accumulates in a fairly deep, circular pool at the foot of the rubble.  Besides the sound of the gurgling water, you hear a low rumble from beyond the obstructing debris.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Lyswe Court]
description: Stretching along the interior stone wall is an expansive courtyard with a dilapidated stone fountain, spouting water from a crack in one side, at its center.  Tall brown stone buildings line the courtyard, while green weeds grow up out of the cracks in the uneven cobblestone road.  The walls meet at a tall black iron gate that exits the village.

title: [Covert Couriers, Basement]
description: Filth and grime cover every inch of the surfaces down here.  A small wet drip plinks somewhere off in the dark, and a musty stench permeates the air.  The only light to speak of glimmers through the warped floorboards above your head.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Mark Alley]
description: Tall, dented poles hold iron lanterns at the alley's entrance, though the narrow passage is by far more shadow than light.  The building on the south side bears only one balcony, upon which several pigeons roost.  A pile of rubble beneath the balcony is spattered with weeks' worth of bird droppings.

Tall, holly-spiralled poles hold iron lanterns at the alley's entrance, though the narrow passage is by far more shadow than light.  The building on the south side bears only one balcony, upon which tri-colored geese roost.  A pile of rubble beneath the balcony is covered in a fine dusting of snow.

title: [Shadowed Light]
description: The subtle smell of old blood lingers in the air as dried pools of the sanguineous substance, along with various drips, mar the already damaged wood floors.  A series of hangers hang from rusted hooks protruding from soiled walls, with small oil lanterns between them.  Resting against a far wall is a pine table, its surface bare save for a few scraps of paper.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Gloam Pike]
description: The sharply angled intersection comes to a point at a giant pine tree easily higher than any giantman that may happen by.  The cobblestones are dusted with its needles, providing a slippery yet quietly fragrant path.  An arrow-shaped wooden sign points southeast.

title: [Make Your Mark]
description: Despite the worsening condition of the exterior of the tower, the inside is clean and neatly furnished with numerous bookshelves.  The grass making its way between the cracks in the cobblestone floor has been meticulously trimmed, and the walls behind the pewter-caged lanterns providing illumination have been scrubbed clean of soot.  A lacquered linden table has been carved to follow the gentle curve of the circular tower wall, its surface covered by a woven sapphire blue table runner.

title: [Black Hand, Draccor's Haunt]
[Black Hand, Game Room]
description: The energy of the cavern echoes off the walls as patrons are camouflaged under a thick haze of hazelnut cigar smoke.  Sanguine leather bar stools line a sturdy ebonwood bar that curves outward to provide ample room behind the bar for shelves of various liquor from across Elanthia.  The expansive floor plan opens up to reveal a dart board, which receives the only splash of light in the grotto.  A dimly lit inlet in the rock houses a series of sleek cream leather booths creating an intimate atmosphere.

title: [Black Hand, Brewery]
description: The air is slightly damp, the silence of the rocky chamber broken by the quiet sound of water dripping far off in the distance.  A tremendous copper drum rises from the floor in the center of the room, tapering to a rounded peak near the ceiling to form a massive still.  Old, iron-banded vats line the walls, forming two rows of oak aisles among the space.  Off to the side, an ebonwood table holds some corked bottles of pale liquid, while a charcoal marble fireplace provides the only light in the space.

title: [Black Hand, Docks]
description: The dark cavern's cool air carries a musty scent of damp wood and stone.  Torches along the rough stone walls offer just enough flame to blacken the craggy ceiling above them.  Obsidian black water surrounds a pair of weathered wooden docks that terminate at large fel-framed doors crudely carved into the cavern wall.  An old, tethered rowboat facing the cavern mouth occasionally draws near its anchor post and knocks against it.

title: [Black Hand, Old Warehouse]
description: The large double sliding doors open to a poorly lit warehouse with a thick cedar floor covered with dust and scuff marks.  Stacks of crates and boxes occupy several marked locations on the floor, designated for storage and delivery.  Near the rear wall is a simple wooden desk covered in piles of stained paper.

title: [Black Hand, Botanist Lab]
description: The faint smells of tobacco, vanilla, and flora intoxicate the area.  Water tumbles down the eastern side of the cave's wall in a cascading miniature waterfall that forms into a pool surrounded by an array of wildflowers and moss.  A series of intertwining ivy stretches towards a single burst of moonlight that streams through a hole in the ceiling bathing the garden.  Shelves that have been carved into the rock hold an array of vials and flasks, while a burnished kakore table sits off to the corner.

title: [Black Hand, Supply Room]
description: A plush velvet charcoal sofa wraps around the cavern walls, and large pieces of aubergine ramie silk drape down from the ceiling providing a pop of color and texture to the room.  Spaced evenly in front of the long sofa are rounded glaes tables etched with a tessellated pattern.  Carved into the far wall is a huge steel vault, gems and coins scattered across the stone floor in front.  Silhouettes of different shapes fill the lounge, the shadows dancing in the warm flicker of some vaalin sconces.

title: [Saewehna Jungle, Mushroom Bed]
description: The maze of trees begins to thin, though the canopy of leaves still blots out much of the moonlight.  Normally sturdy, the soil increasingly becomes waterlogged toward the east, the muddy conditions making travel difficult.  As the atmosphere becomes dank, the vividly hued flowers make way for more subdued fungi and mosses.  Clustering around the base of one of the larger trees, a number of pale white mushrooms brighten the area.
to.location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Sunholm, The Battlements]
description: Protected by its crenellated parapet, the alure of the keep stretches between twin turrets, their azure-on-white pennons stark against the night sky.  Below, the inner ward and its guarded buildings fan out, illuminated within the bastioned curtain walls of the stronghold.  Beyond, the dark of the night swallows much of the countryside, save the dancing glows of caravansary campfires nestled below Vornavis' clifftop enceinte and the streetlights of the Freeport of Solhaven, dimly flickering in the night.

Protected by its crenellated parapet,  the alure of the keep stretches between twin turrets, their azure-on-white pennons streaming against the daylight sky.  Below, the inner ward and its guarded buildings fan out, and beyond the bastioned outer curtain wall the Cairnfang River stretches west towards the sea and Solhaven, opposite the east's vast plains and hills.  Southward, the tall blue granite walls of Vornavis' clifftop enceinte stand fast, while north lays an unending wilderness framed by mountains.

title: [Sunholm, The Hall of the Sun]
description: Above the colossal hall, rows of argent banners blazoned by azure sunbursts hang from immense wooden trusses.  Tall stained glass windows set into stone arches stretch skyward, their mottled light illuminating the granite tiled floor, each flanked by wall-mounted arms of all types.  A vast round table surrounded by heavy wooden chairs dominates the center of the hall, and at its end an immense stone hearth regally occupies a dais below a grand azurite stone sun supported by numerous heraldic shields.

title: [Hinklehorn's, Hidden Hideaway]
description: Some colorful cushions are spread around the room near a small bar that is set in the far corner.  Hung between a misshapen hole in the wall and a lavender silk curtain is a gilded mahogany sign.

title: [Hinklehorn's, Haggard Hookup]
description: Against the far wall, a doorless wardrobe is pushed up against one side of a three-legged table to keep it from falling over.  A collection of hastily hastily nailed boards serves as a makeshift rack, which looks nearly ready to fall from where it is hooked to the wall.  An odd set of muddy footprints leads from a dirt-caked oak door and seems to disappear amongst the rest of the dirt covering the floor.

title: [Caligos Isle, Fishing Jetty]
description: Sharp gusts whip salty spray over massive squares of arm-width granite, their surfaces roughly carved with palm-sized spirals, creating a stable walkway that snakes out into the obsidian ocean shrouded by viscous mist.  Sharp volcanic glass spires rise up to pierce the surface of the churning waters, as waves lap at the sheer drop-offs and black sandy beaches on either side of the walkway.  Flotsam gathers along the coasts that extend perpendicular to the jetty, into the grey mists that clutch at the island.

title: [Caligos Isle, Village]
description: Cracked foundations are all that remain of single-room homes that once stood upon this sandy shore.  Splintered, warped, and shattered floorboards fill the rough square shapes, though the wooden lengths are waterlogged and riddled with barnacles.  To the northwest, large poles hint that a pier may once have stood there, but the timbers that allowed passage and access long ago rotted away.

A scattering of single-room homes have been erected along the sandy shore, their planks painted in a myriad of colorful tones and adorned with shells and bits of driftwood.  Large wooden poles, wrapped in a lattice of sun-bleached cotton ribbons, provide a foundation for a half-built pier, the remaining materials neatly stacked safely away from the day-to-day hustle of the residents.  The aroma of fish and vegetables emanates from one of the open windows, combining with the brininess of the oceanic air.
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, south, southwest, west

title: [The Favored Few, Showroom]
description: Four massive white columns stand at the corners of this raised pavilion.  Draped around and between them are large swathes of white silk.  Bright lights are carefully placed so as to be diffused by the silk, blunting their effect while still providing plenty of light.  A free-standing armor rack stretches across one wall of the pavilion, and a low marble table dominates the center of the space.  A scrollworked plaque is prominently mounted on one of the colums.

Four massive white columns stand at the corners of this raised pavilion.  Draped around and between them are large swathes of white silk.  Bright lights are carefully placed so as to be diffused by the silk, blunting their effect while still providing plenty of light.  A free-standing armor rack stretches across one wall of the pavilion, and a low marble table dominates the center of the space.  A scrollworked plaque is prominently mounted on one of the columns.  You also see some black marble steps leading back to the main grounds.

title: [Caligos Isle, Cliff Trail]
description: The path narrows here, and beyond the edge lies a steep dropoff where tiers of hexagonal basalt columns present evidence of the dire consequences of falling.  Steam rises between the stone pillars in grey tendrils, the moisture collecting on the uneven rock face.  The bleached-white skeletal remains of a few sea birds scattered atop the black basalt columns have been picked clean and glitter almost picturesquely in the moonlight.

The path narrows here, and beyond the edge lies a steep dropoff where tiers of hexagonal basalt columns present evidence of the dire consequences of falling.  Steam rises between the stone pillars in grey tendrils, the moisture collecting on the uneven rock face.  Black-headed gulls circle overhead, dropping shells onto the the broken basalt columns.  Their piercing cries dissipate in the wind as they dive to retrieve their succulent prizes.

title: [Clovertooth Hall, Rotunda]
description: Quasi-circular in design, the rotunda-style walkway of this portion of Clovertooth Hall mimics the round shape of the frosted red and ice blue-hued glass dome far above you.  A candle and crystal chandelier adorned with pearlescent saber-tooth tiger incisors on a long, golden chain fills the area with the amplified glow of refracted candlelight.  Set back a few feet from the top of the stair, a tiny halfling child statue leaning casually against a decorative railing serves as a bit of conceptual installation art.  Younger visitors passing by stop to strike a pose beside it before their parents shoo them on.

title: [Clovertooth Hall, Saferoom]
description: Judging from the time-rounded stones and smooth floor, the saferoom is old, but it is kept free of dust.  Crates and barrels full of preserved foodstuffs are stacked floor to ceiling, filling the air with the sharp odor of brine and more muted hints of dry meat and fish.  A large metal lever protrudes from one wall.

title: [Formal Dining Room]
description: Subdued light provides the room with a warm glow as beeswax candles flicker in balenite sconces that line the honey oak walls.  A large umcor tapestry occupies one wall, while the others are adorned with smaller arras of varying cultural origins.  A long mahogany dining table lined with silk-cushioned high-back chairs dominates the room.  The scent of freshly baked bread wafts through a pair of white oak doors as they swing open for waitstaff delivering trays to a cherrywood sideboard.  A neat rubbish canister is tucked away in one corner.

title: [Clovertooth, Kitchen]
description: A pair of swinging white oak doors separates the kitchen and dining room, sealing off some of the noise from the bustling staff at work.  A large fel cupboard occupies one corner, its doors ajar, revealing shelves stacked with fresh fruit and prepared desserts.  The white marble counter is laden with cutting boards and a variety of knives and utensils.  A red-faced halfling chef threatens his assistants with a rolling pin as they scurry about the kitchen preparing dishes for the guests in the dining room.

title: [Icemule Defenses, South Wall]
description: An immense barbican stands sentry over the wide South Gate of Icemule Trace, and the eastern tower stands high over this portion of the wall.  A small window provides the only means of entry, but it is far too high to access without some help from above.  To the north, the wall looks over Barter Alley to Tartifact's Bakery and the other shops of Trader's Way.

title: [South Barbican, East Tower]
description: The brisk winds of the north flow through the numerous windows that line the circular, stone walls.  Tattered bits of leather and cloth sit beneath the narrow slits, the stains on them a telltale sign of the many battles fought from these heights.  A particularly wide window opens up to the east, and a length of thick rope is tied to a grommet at its base.

title: [Icemule Defenses, South Wall]
description: The wide South Wall looks down over the well-traveled confined of Bootlegger's Alley, which skirts between the wall and several of the most-patronized businesses in the city.  Across the alley to the north lie the grounds of House White Haven, while the view to the south is dominated by impenetrable forest.  Immediately to the east is the western barbican tower of the city's South Gate, which offers access only via an impossibly high window.

title: [South Barbican, West Tower]
description: The shallow steps of the winding stairway taper off at a round room marked by a group of narrow slitted windows.  Pale starlight shines through the narrow gaps in the stone, shimmering wanly against the bits of ice formed along their edges.  A steel grommet fixed beneath one of the wider windows holds a long length of rope.

title: [Icemule Defenses, East Wall]
description: The wall to the south is dominated by the barbican over the East Gate of the city.  A tall barbican tower stands just south of this position, and a single window high above provides the only point of access from the wall.  The curious odor of medicinal tart-baking wafts from Ma Leaftoe's shop on the other side of Fear Alley.

title: [East Barbican, North Tower]
description: A circle of windows looks out onto the surrounding landscape from the top of the tower, each offering as its view only a thin slice of the world as its view because of the arched, slit-like construction.  A few stick-like markings mar the otherwise smooth stone surface beneath the windows -- the arcane figures likely the handiwork of some rather bored guardsman.  A long, thick rope has been tied to a grommet beneath the widest of the windows, permitting access to the eastern wall below.

title: [Icemule Defenses, East Wall]
description: The wall ends in a tall barbican tower to the north, keeping watch over the East Gate of Icemule Trace.  A few adventurers wander through the gate at all times of day and night, some eager to test themselves against the wilds and some bearing the wounds and treasure that mark the relative success of their ventures.  To the west across the narrow Trade Alley stands the city jail.

title: [East Barbican, South Tower]
description: A variety of thick wooden planks provides a sturdy footing at the top of the staircase, the walls opening up into a variety of narrow slitted windows.  Various scuffs, nicks and scorches mar the otherwise smooth stone walls, a telltale sign of the many battles fought here.  A larger window harbors a long piece of rope tied to a grommet, the majority of its length arranged in long serpentine coils.

title: [Icemule Defenses, West Wall]
description: Off in the distance lie the high Ice Plains behind their sturdy rolaren gate.  In the opposite direction stands the impressive structure of Silverwood Manor.  The wall itself is empty except for the ubiquitous snow and ice, which seems determined to claim the structure as its own.

Both sides of the wall are similarly cloaked in darkness.  On the city side, the nearest visible lights come from Silverwood Manor on Cursed Street, almost in the center of town.  The winds howl down the near empty walls, filling the night with a mournful chill.

title: [West Barbican, North Tower]
description: A few simple tokens hang above each narrow slitted window, each marred by some faint scar, dent, or tear.  Dark planks harboring black stains in the wood make up the floor, their short railings ensuring that none will take a rather nasty plunge to the floor far below.  A length of knotted rope is gathered beneath a grommet set into the wall beneath one of the wider windows to allow access to the west wall.

title: [Icemule Defenses, West Wall]
description: The wall comes to an end at the tall barbican tower rising over the West Gate of the city.  A window provides the only access to the tower, and that only from the most difficult height.  To the west can be seen the Warrior's Guild compound and the Nightowl Pub, while immediately beneath the wall a variety of unsavory types make their way down the narrow thoroughfare known as Brewer's Alley.

title: [West Barbican, South Tower]
description: The stairs come to an end in this upper room, where a rough construction of planks and reinforced wood forms a small platform giving access to slitted windows in the walls.  A stunted little barrel stands between the gaps of the numerous slitted windows that encircle the area.  One wider window looks down upon the western wall of Icemule Trace, and a knotted rope is tied to a grommet securely fastened to its stony ledge.

title: [Cholen's Temple, Wine Storage]
description: Huge redwood racks line the stone walls from floor to ceiling, each nearly full to capacity with colorful bottles.  Thin bands of icy blue rhimar are visible here and there on the racks, and a faint swirl of cool mist eddies around the chamber.  Sconces set at intervals along the wine racks support tiny globes of pale, steady light.  A heavy redwood door is set into the south wall, while a short stair on the east side of the room leads down to a similarly robust door.

title: [Bard Guild, Great Hall]
description: Large windows covering the east and west walls of the Great Hall stand open to catch the salt-scented breeze blowing in off the Bay.  The beaded ceiling above is rich-toned teak, and ceiling fans suspended from it turn at a lazy pace.
