title: [Kestrel's Perch, Studio]
description: Glass doors across the far wall have been folded back, opening the room to the garden beyond.  Thick, rustic wooden beams along the ceiling contrast the white walls and woven rugs strewn across the stone floor.  Surrounded by chairs, a white pine table dominates the room beneath a trio of wicker lanterns.  Tucked in the corner, a pot-bellied stove sits besides an ornate andiron well-stocked with firewood.  Reclaimed wood shelves line opposing walls, interspersed with artwork in varied styles and mediums.

title: [Tideswept Bazaar]
description: Glasstide roses bloom in fragile clusters secreted among the rocky walls, their translucent petals refracting the shifting light.  A jagged archway of stone marks the entrance to the bazaar that stretches over a soft, sandy bottom where rippling currents carve delicate patterns in the grains.  Vivid corals in deep blues, golds, and crimsons cling to the walls, their branching forms creating a labyrinth of color.  Schools of fish dart past drifting strands of sea flora swaying with the tide.

title: [Ebb and Flow]
description: Elaborately paneled with a mosaic of coral, the ceiling rises high above in a dome of brilliant, vivid colors that depict the bed of an ocean.  Rays of natural light from narrow slats in the ceiling penetrate swathes of chiffon in shades of blue, green, and silver cut to resemble ocean currents cascading down from above.  Shelves are built into the walls and a few racks are placed about the room to display items for sale.

title: [Selinth Verge]
description: Coral formations cluster across the cavern floor, rising in layered ridges and spirals.  A smooth stone ledge juts out above, running along one wall with a clear view of the space below.  Near the far end, a slender crevice splits the rock, its interior obscured by shadow and drifting silt.  Water moves slowly through the chamber, stirring strands of algae and casting shifting patterns across the walls.

title: [Selinth Cavern]
description: Worn stone walls enclose the cavern where a twisted driftwood table rests near a broad coral pool that fills most of the space.  Along the ledge, a narrow fissure cuts through rock, vanishing into shadow.  Light from a small torch flickers over the surface of the water in shifting lines as slow currents drift past.  Arcing formations create an irregular ceiling above, enclosing the space in layered curves.

title: [Singing Crags, Kapok Tree]
description: A massive kapok sprawls atop rugged hills, some of its sprawling limbs bound with coarse vines to form treacherous platforms.  Near its apex, scratched runes and old blood mar the tree's bole.  Decaying nests of jungle twigs and leaves and dried mud cling precariously to the branches.  They emit a sour odor of spoiled meat.  Occasional feathers spiral lazily downward from the crude nests, caught in swirling currents of befouled air.

title: [Singing Crags, Grove]
description: Tall trees shade the rugged stone of the hills, sheltered enough from the stunting wind by higher hills to have grown to staggering heights.  One kapok tree scrapes the sky, faces carved into its lower trunks cast in shadow by its immense branches, which are strung with primitive ornaments made from bone, feather, and twine.  High overhead, crude platforms and thatch-roofed dwellings peek from within the foliage, nearly hidden by the dense greenery.

title: [The Tonbury, Cargo Hold]
description: Moldy crates glisten with a thick veneer of briny grime, any clues to their origins lost to time's ravages.  Waterlogged barrels drift, half-submerged, through deep waters that rise and fall with the pounding of the surf outside.  Overhead, slouching beams drip befouled water, dangling the rusted remnants of lantern chains that once lit mildewed steps leading out of the hold.  There is a stale smell to the dark, dank air.

title: [The Tonbury, Main Deck]
description: Planks of ebon-hued cypress are silty with the clumpy powder leaking from toppled barrels along the deck.  Fragments of netting, bleached to charcoal grey, dangle from corroded stays, flicking against masts crusty with salt deposits.  A skeleton leaned up against the base of one mast still clutches a rusted iron cup between bony hands as if about to drink, and the metal and bone rattle together unsettlingly in the breeze.  The dead sailor's eye sockets balefully watch the hold's dark entrance.

title: [Kragnek-Dzu, Hot Spring]
description: Rising steam forms into layers of mist and fog that turbulently shift across the surface of the opaque, pale white waters of the bubbling spring.  A stream of the upwelled water has carved its way through the irregularly shaped rocks surrounding the spring, splashing along some carved grey granite steps leading to Stone Mill Road.

title: [Kragnek-Dzu, Stone Mill Road]
description: The cobblestones of the promenade come to a sudden end, transitioning into a rugged gravel road.  Alongside the road is a narrow stream that gushes forth from a bubbling hot spring, its surface layered with roiling fog.  A stout stone mill resides between the promenade and the spring, its waterwheel turning steadily in the rushing waters.  Berry-laden bushes grow between mushroom-covered mangroves along the opposite bank.

title: [River Muagh, Mouth]
description: A churning black maelstrom blocks the sky on the eastern, seaward facing side of lifeless, dark cliffs that flank the river along both banks.  The wind whips about with an intensity only rivaled by dwarves charging toward free ale, and surging waves from the Obsidian Sea meet the River Muagh head on.  A battered raft tethered to a jagged basalt ledge is caught in a constant, turbulent mix of brackish water, tossed one way, then the other.

title: [River Muagh, Basalt Ledge]
description: The angled surface of the ledge is worn smooth from countless years of scouring rain, though its seaward-facing edge is sharp and jagged from undercutting waves battering it relentlessly.  Fierce swells continuously crash against a row of basalt rocks near a dark cave leading into the cliffside, forcing seawater violently upward toward the churning maelstrom that roils across the skyline.

title: [A Carpeted Landing]
description: Crystal droplets, pendants, and beads draped over an elaborate gold leaf frame create a dazzling display of illumination in the grand stairwell of the hotel.  Framed by gilded railings on both sides, the centerpiece is a sweeping, curved staircase, clad in polished mahogany and adorned with a crimson carpet featuring gold floral motifs.  A dried garland of purplish black hissing ivy and midnight belladonna cascades down each banister, filling the air with a sweet, yet acrid, fragrance.

title: [Seventh Floor, Front Stairs]
description: A sweeping staircase of dark polished mahogany rises gracefully to the upper floors, the lofty stairwell illuminated by the soft, flickering light of a large silver candelabrum.  The rail curves in a graceful arc, its banister broad enough to slide down its length.  To one side of the landing, an arched doorway opens into a long, carpeted hallway that leads deeper into the hotel.

title: [Hearth's Desire]
description: A glinting blanket of snow covers the tall ironwood trunks along the periphery of the encampment, the rope-secured barricades spaced with iron-caged braziers forged into vertical tusks.  Frost-covered barrels sit clustered across the straw-strewn dirt, the makeshift seating encircling the pole-framed bonfire contained between the weathered rocks set in a wide circle.  Steady light radiates from the flag-adorned structures at the back of the encampment as a steady stream of cooking smoke rises above.

title: [Cold River, Issenflow Banks]
description: A sluggish flow of crystal clear water laps languidly at snow-clad banks.  Though the river is ebon in the twilight, the ripples of the aurora reflect in distorted tangles over its waters, the colors dancing across a nearby a log-framed encampment.  The far shore is lost in a blanket of thick mist that prowls low over the river's surface.  Fishing poles lean against the rear wall of a nearby hut with a pine-and-pitch facade, though a nearby spruce drying rack is bare of fish.

title: [Militia Keep, Tower]
description: A precisely angled ceiling of thick iron plates arcs overhead, supported by the carved stone that makes up the tower.  Several windows surround the cramped chamber, offering views just large enough to take in the sprawl of the city below.  Each wall has been affixed with carefully arranged racks of provisions, keeping the floor free of clutter while allowing adequate room around the large ballista.

title: [Militia Keep, Barracks]
description: Plenty of torches line the walls of the barracks, illuminating the area sharply.  Four thick stone pillars are scattered across the room to support the ceiling, each displaying the Militia's coat-of-arms upon golden tapestries.  Several tables and chairs are bunched up in the center of the room, offering plenty of seating while simple cots and cotton hammocks line the walls for those who need rest.  Pushed up against the eastern wall is an iron and modwir credenza.

title: [Moat, Bottom]
description: The moat floor is just within reach, if you wanted to tempt the black, eyeless creatures that scuttle along through the muck.  You can just make out the outlines of a hundred years' worth of junk that has had the misfortune of finding its way to the moat bottom.

title: [Moat, Underwater]
description: Your eyes strain to find any light in the murky black water, but there is none.  The cold and pressure indicate that you are deep below the water's surface.

back_command: ;e waitfor 'and pull you down even further into the murk'

title: [Black Swan Castle, Ramparts]
description: The tallest tower of the fortress provides the highest point for detecting enemy onslaughts.  The thin and elegant stone structure seems to stretch and crane over the landscape, like some vigilant bird poised to take flight at the first sign of attack.  Two windows, now like lifeless eye sockets, are sunk into the western and southern curves of the tower.

title: [Black Swan Castle, Tower]
description: This is the lookout floor of the tower.  A spiral black marble stair winds its way down in the center, while a granite platform carved into the walls allows access to the north and east doors, and the south and west windows, for watches and emergencies.

title: [Black Swan Castle, Ramparts]
description: The ramparts here are not in such an advanced state of disrepair behind the lookout tower.  The dark granite is mostly unmarred on both the inner and outer walls.  This area seems to have been spared from the full force of enemy attacks.

title: [Black Swan Castle, Tower]
description: This is the lookout floor of the tower.  A spiral black marble stair winds its way down in the center, while a granite platform carved into the walls allows access to the north and east doors, and the south and west windows, for watches and emergencies.

title: [The Resonant Hull, Deck]
description: Weathered cypress and aged cedar form this double-masted vessel, its hull and railings lacquered in deep vermilion.  Two angular fin-shaped sails rise from the deck like the wings of a folding screen, while the vessel's heart houses a small-roofed chamber, its sliding paper-paneled screens and graceful hipped roof framed by natural wood planking.  Bare plank decking runs stem to stern between carved rail posts, where a narrow boarding ramp extends like an outstretched hand.

title: [Corsairs' Corner]
description: The battered teak dock makes an abrupt right angle turn, reducing the capacity for docking vessels somewhat.  A colorful sea glass kraken cuddled up with a bevy of merpeople has been inlaid into the center of the deck with the phrase, "Something for everyone at the Great Piratical Flotilla," carved beneath it.  Barnacle-encrusted posts and seaweed-covered bumpers mark off individual docking slips.

title: [The Kraken's Dispatch, Deck]
description: Polished from stem to stern, the ship has pristine sails painted with the flotilla's signature ebon kraken floating in a crimson pool on a field of emerald green.  Large crates are stacked everywhere, each stamped with various ports of call and the phrase, "Mail for the Flotilla if you can find it."  A spacious staircase leads down, with a neatly lettered sign right next to it.

title: [Seafarers' Shops]
description: Expansive in both width and length, the battered teak dock has several slips for visiting ships, each with several salt-stained buoys.  Several deep scratches mar the deck in unusual, circular patterns, as if a giant tentacle had smacked the deck multiple times in succession.
